Translation of Exhibit No. 3 dropped by the 1st accused
Yang Yin Ling(楊一林) at No. 677 Changping Road on
March 8, 1931.

WORKING PLAN FOR FEBRUARY

In compliance with the general plans of Central,
the following activities will be undertaken:-

(1) Consolidation of principal organs:-
a) Chief of the Executive Bureau of the National Labour
Federation: The Shantung delegate to the 5th Plenary
Session will be appointed Chairman of the Committee of
the Shanghai Labour Federation. Lau Sung Lee(老宋)
will be appointed Acting Chief of the Executive Bureau
of the National Labour Federation.

b) Executive Staff of the Central Propaganda Department:-
Withdraw the tailor and instruct either Toh Foe(托夫)
or Liao Sih Kwang(廖錫昆) to work with the Executive
Staff.

c) Chairman of Military Committee.

d) Executive Staff of Peasants' Committee.

e) Shanghai Labour Federation: The Shantung delegate
will be appointed Chairman of the Committee.

f) Manchurian Committee: To transfer a member of the
Shansi Special Committee for work in Manchuria, and to
instruct Comrade Yang Poo(楊波), member of the
Delegation to Eastern Manchuria, to participate in the
work of the Manchurian Provincial Committee.

g) Szechwan Provincial Committee: To instruct Ah Kung(阿根)
and Kwoh Poo(郭天) to work on the Szechwan Provincial
Committee.

h) To send responsible persons to Hupeh, Honan, and Anhwei.

i) Proposals relating to the Central Bureau of Soviet Areas
in Szechwan and Shansi.

j) Assistance to Kiangsu.

(2) Important Duties:-
1) The transfer of information relating to the 5th Plenary
Session.
2) The Conference of Soviet Representatives and the Movement
to support the Red Army.
3) Movement to support the Soviet.
4) Unemployment movement.
5) Anti-Imperialist movement.
6) Assisting in the convocation of a conference of Shanghai
Wharf Workers and the organization of a Federation of
Wharf Workers.

(3) Work in Provincial Districts:-
1) Work in Hupeh, Honan, and Shansi.
2) Improving the work along the Nanking Railway(Kiangsu).
3) Promoting the work in Northern Anhwei.
4) Work done along the borders of Hupeh and Honan.

(4) Executive Staff:-

二月份工作计划

根据中央的总体计划，将开展以下活动：-

(1) 主要机构的巩固：-
a) 全国劳工联合会执行局主任：出席第五届全会的山东代表将被任命为上海劳工联合会委员会主席。老宋（Lau Sung Lee）将被任命为全国劳工联合会执行局代理主任。

b) 中央宣传部执行人员：-
撤回裁缝，并指示托夫（Toh Foe）或廖錫昆（Liao Sih Kwang）与执行人员一起工作。

c) 军事委员会主席。

d) 农民委员会执行人员。

e) 上海劳工联合会：山东代表将被任命为委员会主席。

f) 满洲委员会：调派一名山西特委成员前往满洲工作，并指示赴东满代表团成员杨波（Yang Poo）同志参与满洲省委的工作。

g) 四川省委：指示阿根（Ah Kung）和郭天（Kwoh Poo）在四川省委工作。

h) 派遣负责人前往湖北、河南和安徽。

i) 关于四川和山西苏区中央局的提案。

j) 对江苏的援助。

(2) 重要任务：-
1) 传递有关第五届全会的信息。
2) 苏维埃代表会议及支援红军运动。
3) 支援苏维埃运动。
4) 失业运动。
5) 反帝运动。
6) 协助召开上海码头工人会议并组织码头工人联合会。

(3) 各省地区的工作：-
1) 湖北、河南和山西的工作。
2) 改善京沪铁路（江苏）沿线的工作。
3) 推动皖北的工作。
4) 鄂豫边界地区的工作。

(4) 执行人员：-

TRANSLATION OF EXHIBIT NO. 5 DROPPED BY 1ST ACCUSED
YANG YIH LING(楊一林) AT NO.677 CHANGPING ROAD

Decision to dismiss Mah Ziang Sung
and Lau Tsang etc. from the Party.
------------------------------------

Mah Ziang Sung(馬祥生) and Lau Tsang(老竹),
natives of Tientsin, attached to the Federation of
Printing Workers, have been proved to be negligent
of their duty. They brought doubtful characters
to their offices and this resulting in the disappearance
of certain comrades connected with them. They then
changed their addresses without making a report and
are now in hiding. Doubtless, they have turned
traitors and are now in the employ of our enemies.
Consequently, the District Committee has decided to
dismiss them from the Party permanently and desires
to warn all comrades to be careful.
page_data.zh:
第一被告杨一林（楊一林）在昌平路677号丢弃的证物第5号译文

关于开除马祥生
及老竹等人党籍的决定。
------------------------------------

马祥生（Mah Ziang Sung）和老竹（Lau Tsang），
天津人，隶属于印刷工人联合会，已被证实玩忽职守。他们将有嫌疑的人物带入其办公地点，导致与他们有关联的某些同志失踪。随后，他们未作报告便更改地址，目前处于隐匿状态。毫无疑问，他们已叛变，现受雇于我们的敌人。因此，区委决定永久将他们开除出党，并希望警告所有同志务必小心谨慎。

page_data.en:
Translation of Exhibit No.6 dropped by 1st accused Yung
Yin Ling (楊林) at No.677 Changping Road on 2/3/34

Letter No.2, 1934.

Brother Kwok Wen (國文)
1) Tsoong Tsing Poh (清福) and N:ah (哈) have safely
returned to Kuala Lumpur. They report that you have
simply given them some literature (one copy each of
the "Struggle" issues 56, 58 59 and 60; one copy of
"Letter to Chinese Communist Party from the Presidium
of the 3rd International", one copy of the "General
Principles of Prona anda in connection with the
Fokien Incident", and one copy of the "Manifesto re-
lating to the Sino-Japanese Direct Negotiations) and
a sum of $110. for travelling expenses, but you did
not give them any particular work.

2) We recently met a Javanese comrade named "Monica" of
the American Communist Party. He states that he is
a member of the Communist Party in New York where he
once participated in the work of the Party and the
Labour Federation. In December, 1932, by order of
the American Communist Party, he left New York for
Shanghai in a cargo boat the "City of Uninusor" (?)
on which he was employed as a worker. The ship ar-
rived in Shanghai in February, 1932 (?1933). On the
date of arrival, at 7 p.m. he waited in the "middle"
cabin for your representative, because, according to
arrangement, your representative would call on him
with the words "Green and Smith". However, he
waited for five days without being approached by
anybody and then he returned in the same ship to
Kuala Lumpur from where he intended to return to
New York. Upon arrival at Kuala Lumpur, however, he
was dismissed from the ship and was thus compelled
to remain in Selambang for over ten months. He was
only recently recommended by a comrade, whom he knew
formerly in Java, to join the Red Labour Union here.
He has decided to return to New York in the near
future but we have asked him to remain here as we
are in need of him. He is still here but we have
not yet formally established connections with him.
He is about 28 or 29 years of age of strong
build. He was a student and at one time became a
labour. He is well versed in the English and Dutch
Languages (about secondary school grade), knows a
little Malayan language, and can speak some Indian
dialects. His attitude towards revolution is firm,
and he has a clear conception of the principle of
the Party and politics. Do you know anything about
this Comrade? If what he has told us is true, can
he be recommended for work with us? We wish to know
your opinion regarding him.

3) The Central of the Chinese Communist Youth League
formerly promised to recommend to us a comrade who
had been deported by the Chinese Government to
the Netherlands East Indies. This man was born in
the Netherlands East Indies and is of dual nationality
(Netherland and Chinese). We are now in urgent need
of such a comrade.

4) We are too busy at present to write a report on the
work done by us. We shall send a comrade to Shanghai
to report to you in person.

5) We hope you will send us a subsidy without delay.

1934年2月3日，第一被告杨林（Yung Yin Ling / 楊林）在昌平路677号丢弃的证物第6号译文

1934年第2号信。

国文（Kwok Wen）兄
1) 清福（Tsoong Tsing Poh）和哈（N:ah）已安全返回吉隆坡。他们报告说，你仅给了他们一些文献（《斗争》第56、58、59和60期各一份；《共产国际执行委员会致中国共产党书》一份；《关于福建事变的一般原则》一份，以及《关于中日直接谈判的宣言》一份）和$110.旅费，但你并未给他们安排任何具体工作。

2) 我们最近遇到了一位名叫“莫妮卡”（Monica）的美共爪哇同志。他声称自己是纽约共产党成员，曾在那里参与党和劳工联合会的工作。1932年12月，奉美共命令，他离开纽约前往上海，乘坐一艘名为“City of Uninusor” (?) 的货船，他在船上担任工人。该船于1932年2月（?1933年）抵达上海。抵达当日晚上7点，他在“中等”舱室等候你的代表，因为根据安排，你的代表会用“Green and Smith”作为暗号与他联系。然而，他等了五天无人接洽，随后便乘同一艘船返回吉隆坡，打算从那里返回纽约。然而，抵达吉隆坡后，他被船方解雇，因此被迫在Selambang停留了十个多月。直到最近，经一位他以前在爪哇认识的同志推荐，他才加入此地的红色工会。他决定不久后返回纽约，但我们因需要他而要求他留下。他目前仍在此地，但我们尚未与他建立正式联系。他大约28或29岁，体格强壮。他曾是一名学生，后来成为工人。他精通英语和荷兰语（约中学水平），懂一点马来语，并能说一些印度方言。他对革命态度坚定，对党的原则和政治有清晰的认识。你对这位同志有所了解吗？如果他所言属实，能否推荐他为我们工作？我们希望知道你对他的看法。

3) 中国共产主义青年团中央此前曾承诺向我们推荐一名被中国政府驱逐至荷属东印度的同志。此人出生于荷属东印度，拥有双重国籍（荷兰和中国）。我们现在急需这样一位同志。

4) 我们目前过于繁忙，无法书面汇报我们的工作。我们将派遣一名同志前往上海，当面向你汇报。

5) 希望你们尽快向我们提供津贴。

TRANSLATION OF EXHIBIT NO. 74 SEIZED FROM NO. 677
CHANGPING ROAD ON MARCH 2, 1934.

Address on envelope: Wong Foo Sung(王輔生)
c/o Yui Soong Ts(于才之), Bank of China.

Central,

At the beginning of December of the year before
last (? 1932) I was instructed by Central to undertake
certain activities among the soldiers of the 19th Route
Army. I then proceeded to Amoy in company with the
"clerk" of the Amoy Committee, and after staying there for
about one week, I left for Chienchow by order of the Amoy
Committee to carry out work among the troops of the 61st
Division stationed in that city.

Upon arrival at Chienchow I received the following
information:-

(1) Shortly after their transfer to Southern Fukien, one
Regiment of the 78th Division of the 19th Route Army
stationed near the borders of Soviet Areas rebelled and
joined the Red Army.

(2) Once a meeting of about 40 or 50 persons was discovered
by reactionary senior military officers. In consequence of
this, many party organizations in the 60th and 61st Divisions
were dissolved. Several hundreds of junior officers and
soldiers were secretly executed and many were repatriated
to their natives places.

The Party at Chienchow had been inactive for over
six months before my arrival owing to negligence on the
part of the two leading comrades. I have now succeeded
in re-establishing connection with the 61st Division by
getting into touch with Comrade Yeu(叶) attached to the
3rd Company, Special Service Battalion of the said Division.
In his Company there are 6 comrades and 5 "mass members"
who are on intimate terms with him. The movements of
soldiers are always watched by their senior officers and
"spies" of the Kuomintang.

I have interviewed Comrade Yeu on several occasions
and explained to him the present political situation and the
importance of the movement among the soldiers. At a
meeting held by Comrade Yeu, at which were present an
assistant-commander of the 125th Battalion and a secretary
of the 3rd Company and myself, the following working plans
were decided upon :-

(1) To establish a branch in the 3rd Company with a special
cell in the Cadets Regiment under its supervision. Comrade
Yeu is to act as "Clerk" of the Branch with the Secretary
of the 3rd Company as his assistant.

(2) The Branch to enlist four comrades and the cell two
comrades within two weeks.

(3) The Branch and the Cell to organize within 3 weeks a
volunteer army to proceed to the Northeast to resist Japan.

(4) To issue literature pointing out the traitorous acts
of the Kuomintang and urging soldiers to join the Anti-
Japanese Volunteer Armies.

(5) To organize boxing, chess, football, and amateur
dramatic clubs with the object of uniting the soldiers

1934年3月2日从昌平路677号查获的证物第74号译文。

信封地址：王輔生（Wong Foo Sung）
由中国银行于才之（Yui Soong Ts）转交。

中央，

前年（? 1932年）12月初，我奉中央指示，在第十九路军士兵中开展某些活动。随后，我与厦门委员会的“ clerk ”一同前往厦门，在那里停留约一周后，奉厦门委员会命令前往泉州，在该市驻守的第六十一师部队中开展工作。

抵达泉州后，我收到以下信息：-

(1) 第十九路军第七十八师的一个团在调往闽南后不久，在靠近苏区边界的地方发生兵变，加入了红军。

(2) 一次约有40或50人参加的会议被反动高级军官发现。因此，第六十师和第六十一师中的许多党组织被解散。数百名下级军官和士兵被秘密处决，许多人被遣返原籍。

在我到达之前，由于两名主要负责同志的疏忽，泉州的党组织已停滞超过六个月。目前，我已通过与该师特种服务营第三连的叶（Yeu）同志取得联系，成功重建了与第六十一师的联系。在他的连队中，有6名党员和5名与他关系密切的“群众会员”。士兵的行动始终受到其上级军官和国民党“密探”的监视。

我曾多次会见叶同志，向他解释了当前的政治局势以及在士兵中开展工作的重要性。在一次由叶同志主持的会议上，出席者包括第125营副营长、第三连书记和我本人，会上决定了以下工作计划：-

(1) 在第三连建立支部，并在其监督下于学兵团设立特别小组。叶同志担任支部“书记”，第三连书记担任其助手。

(2) 支部在两周内发展四名党员，小组发展两名党员。

(3) 支部和小组在三周内组织一支志愿军，前往东北抗日。

(4) 发行刊物，指出国民党的叛国行径，并敦促士兵加入抗日志愿军。

(5) 组织拳击、象棋、足球和业余戏剧俱乐部，以团结士兵

page_data.en:
( 2 )

and inducing them to conduct struggles.

(6) To assist the Red Armies by damaging the firearms of
white troops and obstructing the transportation of military
supplies and spreading rumours against the Kuomintang troops
and inducing White soldiers to join the Red Armies.

While working at Chienchow, I received two letters
from the 78th Division stationed at Lung Ngan and Liencheng
reporting on the favourable conditions in their districts.
As it was difficult for me to go there, I submitted a report
on this matter to the Amoy Committee who then sent a comrade
to take my place and instructed me to proceed to Amoy to
attend a conference. When I went to consult with Lai Ts
King(賴金), a traitor named Tsaung Yoh Ying(莊毓英),
who had been shadowing us, called upon the police to arrest
us. Lai was arrested while I fled into the Kulangsu
Settlement and stayed over night in a lodging house there.
Meantime I made arrangements with a "clerk" of the Amoy
Committee to remove all offices known to Lai for fear that
he might eventually surrender to the Kuomintang. I returned
to Chienchow the following day.

About twenty days after, Central, on receipt of a
report from the Amoy Committee, sent another comrade to
Amoy. At that time progress had been made in the activities
among the soldiers of the 61st Division. We have two new
comrades in the Artillery Company and the 2nd Company of
the Special Service Battalion. Comrade Yeu has been
promoted Commander of the 1st Company.

On February 30, the Amoy Committee sent Comrade
Wong to Chienchow to summon me to Amoy. I went there on
March 1 and stayed in a lodging house. When I was leaving
the lodging house on the morning of the third day of my
arrival for the purpose of keeping an appointment, I was
arrested by Chinese police at the instance of Lai who had
turned traitor after his arrest.

(Signed) Yih Van Tshang(葉芸蒼).
February 11.

并诱导他们开展斗争。

(6) 通过破坏白军枪械、阻碍军用物资运输、散布针对国民党军队的谣言以及诱导白军士兵加入红军等方式，援助红军。

我在泉州工作期间，收到驻龙岩和连城的第78师发来的两封信，报告其辖区内的有利形势。由于我难以前往该地，我便就此事项向厦门委员会提交了一份报告，随后厦门委员会派遣一名同志接替我的职务，并指示我前往厦门参加会议。当我去与赖金(賴金)商议时，一名一直跟踪我们的叛徒莊毓英(莊毓英)叫来警察逮捕我们。赖被捕，而我逃入鼓浪屿租界，并在那里的一家客栈过夜。同时，我与厦门委员会的一名“职员”做出安排，将赖所知的所有办公地点全部转移，以防他最终向国民党投降。次日我返回泉州。

约二十天后，中央收到厦门委员会的报告，又派遣另一名同志前往厦门。当时在第61师士兵中的活动已取得进展。我们在炮兵连和特务营第二连发展了两名新同志。尤同志已晋升为第一连连长。

2月30日，厦门委员会派遣黄同志前往泉州召我去厦门。我于3月1日抵达并住进一家客栈。在我到达后的第三天早晨，我离开客栈赴约时，被中国警察逮捕，这是此前被捕后变节的赖所告发的结果。

（签名）葉芸蒼(葉芸蒼)。
2月11日。

SUMMARISED TRANSLATION OF EXHIBIT NO. 75 SEIZED DURING
THE COURSE OF A RAID AT NO. 677 CHANGPING ROAD ON 2.3.34.

1) Report from Shansi Committee, dated 10.2.34

The movement to collect contributions for the
support of Red Armies was carried out for the first
time in Shansi with successful results. More than
600 persons were engaged in this movement and the
majority of the contributors were peasants and labourers
who gave generously.
About 5 or 6 "Red Army Friendly Societies" have been
organized with a total membership of about 30, and
connections with workers of arsenals, railways, printing
works and tailors' shops have been established.

2) Report from Shansi Committee, dated 10.2.34

Particulars of Party and Mass organizations in
Shansi are given hereunder:-
(1) Teachers' Federation - This has a membership of about
15 who are mostly middle school teachers. The
Communist cell established in this Federation is
inefficient and most of its members do not work
regularly.
(2) Mutual Aid Society - This was inaugurated in August
with a membership of 15. Meetings are held regularly
but direct connections with gaols have not yet been
established.
(3) Anti-Imperialist League - This was inaugurated about
two weeks ago with a membership of 12. It has
established two branches and is endeavouring to
develop its movement.
(4) Federation of Left Wing Writers - This organization
will be inaugurated in the near future. It already
has 10 members. Many students have expressed their
willingness to render assistance.
(5) About 5 or 7 "Red Army Friendly Societies" have been
established with a total membership of about 30.

3) Letter from Central Committee of Northern Anhwei
to Fengs Dai Haim (Anhwei) Committee, dated 1.2.34.

The movement of the Party to smash the 5th Anti-
Communist Campaign is being carried out successfully in
various Hsiens in Northern Anhwei. This has incurred
the enmity of the reactionary ruling classes who are now
trying their best to counteract our move. Consequently,
we advise you to pay special attention to the activities
of traitors and to accelerate the work against White
terrorism. You should instruct every revolutionist to
meet interrogations by authorities with false statements
prepared beforehand and to remain loyal to the Party even
after arrest.
As a number of comrades were recently arrested, we
urge you to collect contributions from the revolutionary
masses for the support of their relatives and to issue
manifestoes and posters relating to this matter. In this
connection you should work in cooperation with the Mutual
Aid Society and Anti-Imperialist organizations.

4) Report From An Hui Branch, dated 28.2.34.

Please publish the following in the "Victory News":-
On February 8 the brave guerilla troops of the Red
Army advanced upon two large villages. They seized 8
rifles, two large calibre Banner pistols, over 2000 rounds
of ammunition, and a small sum of money. They also

党粉碎第五次“围剿”的运动在皖北各县顺利开展。这招致了反动统治阶级的敌视，他们正竭力对抗我们的行动。因此，我们建议你们特别注意叛徒的活动，并加速开展反对白色恐怖的工作。你们应指示每一位革命者用事先准备好的假口供应对当局的审讯，并在被捕后保持对党的忠诚。

We send Comrade Li Tsung San(李春山) to Central

Owing to the coronation of Pu Yi, special precautions

TRANSLATION OF ITEM NO. EXHIBIT NO. 77. ATTACHED TO
NO. 877 (KIANGPING ROAD) ON MCH 2, 1934.

THE FUJIAN REVOLT.

1) The Background of the Incident
This incident is the consequence of the
present national crisis as evidenced by the
surrender of the Kuomintang to British, American
and Japanese Imperialists.

2) Economic Crisis
The Kuomintang is at present advocating
the rehabilitation of farming districts and other
arbitrary propaganda. On the other hand, taxes
are being exorbitantly increased, huge foreign
loans contracted, etc.

3) Our Policies
a) We must employ every means at our disposal to
develop our anti-imperialist and anti-Chiang
Kai Shek war front.
b) We must conduct an extensive propaganda to
expose the deceit of the People's Government
of Fukien.
c) We must protest against foreign imperialists
interfering in our national affairs.
d) We must intensify the movement against Fascism
among the masses.
e) We must establish connections with soldiers and
urge them to mutiny, to kill their reactionary
officers, to join the Red Army and to smash the
5th Red Suppression Campaign launched by the
traitor Chiang Kai Shek.

福建事变。

1) 事件背景
此事件是当前民族危机的后果，表现为国民党向英、美和日本帝国主义投降。

2) 经济危机
国民党目前正鼓吹农村复兴及其他任意性的宣传。另一方面，税收被过度增加，巨额外债被举借等。

3) 我们的政策
a) 我们必须利用一切可用手段，发展反帝和反蒋介石战线。
b) 我们必须进行广泛的宣传，揭露福建人民政府的欺骗性。
c) 我们必须抗议外国帝国主义干涉我国内政。
d) 我们必须在群众中加强反对法西斯主义的运动。
e) 我们必须与士兵建立联系，敦促他们哗变，杀死反动军官，加入红军，并粉碎叛徒蒋介石发动的第五次围剿。

TRANSLATION OF ITEM "C", SERIAL NO. 77, ISSUED
at No. 677 Nanking Road on March 2, 1932.

LETTER TO THE KIANGSU PROVINCIAL COMMITTEE
IN CONNECTION WITH DISTRIBUTION WORK.

To the Kiangsu Provincial Committee,

The revolutionary tendencies of the masses
are growing more and more positive as the result of
the partitioning of China by foreign imperialists,
the shameless betrayal of the people's interests by
the Kuomintang and the success scored by the Soviet
Red Army. On this account, the masses are in
urgent need of Party leadership and propaganda matter.

For instance, a female worker of a certain
factory has voluntarily asked to become a member of
the Party because she had read the "News of Victory".
Also, the coolies of a certain wharf have been known
to assemble to read a wall paper and did not disperse
until the poster had been torn away by a policeman.

Despite the urgent needs of the masses, the
Kiangsu Provincial Committee has neglected its
distribution work. The following are the grounds
of our allegation :-

(1) The distribution work does not rest upon the
whole body of comrades of the Provincial Committee
and this work is being regarded by Standing
Committeemen of the various branches of the
Party as being not routine work.

(2) Most of the organizations are defective and some
District Committees are without Distribution
Sections (such as the Wharf District Committee,
the Shanghai Central District Committee, the
Peetung District Committee, the Woosung District
Committee and the Kiangwan District Committee).
In their distribution work the various District
Committees lack contact with their respective
main cells.

(3) The distribution work has no connection with
other activities especially with the struggles
of the masses.

(4) There is no plan or estimate for the distribution
work.

Central Distribution Bureau
February 26.

致江苏省委关于分发工作的信函。

致江苏省委，

由于外国帝国主义瓜分中国、国民党无耻背叛人民利益以及苏联红军取得的胜利，群众的革命倾向日益积极。因此，群众迫切需要一个党的领导权和宣传材料。

例如，某工厂的一名女工因阅读了《胜利新闻》而自愿申请入党。此外，据悉某码头的苦力聚集阅读墙报，直到警察撕掉海报后才散去。

尽管群众有迫切需求，但江苏省委忽视了其分发工作。以下是我们指控的理由：-

(1) 分发工作并未依靠省委全体同志，且各党支部的常务委员将此项工作视为非常规工作。

(2) 大多数组织存在缺陷，一些区委没有设立分发科（如码头区委、上海中心区委、浦东区委、吴淞区委和江湾区委）。在各区委的分发工作中，缺乏与其各自主要支部的联系。

(3) 分发工作与其他活动，特别是与群众斗争，没有联系。

(4) 分发工作没有计划或预算。

中央分发局
2 月 26 日。

TRANSLATION OF ITEM "D", MANIFEST NO. 77 SEIZED AT NO. 677
CHANGPING ROAD ON MARCH 3, 1934.

DRAFT OF ACTIVITIES TO BE UNDERTAKEN BY
THE LABOUR UNION AMONG RICKSHA COOLIES.

Although ricksha transportation is not an industrial
enterprise possessing any fighting significance, yet it is
essential to a revolutionary labour union when the question
of organizing the ricksha coolies and directing their struggles
is taken into consideration.

This may be explained on the following grounds :-

(a) In Shanghai there are nearly 100,000 ricksha coolies.

(b) Of this number, 60% are poor peasants and labourers in
rural districts who have to return every Spring or Summer
to the rural districts in north-west Kiangsu. Our work
among them constitutes a most important link between the
industrial proletariat and the peasants. We should do
our best to utilize this link for the development of our
work among the revolutionary masses in rural districts.
About 25% of the ricksha coolies in Shanghai are dismissed
factory workers who maintain very good relations between
the employed and unemployed workers. Through this, our
labour union can establish numerous connections.

(c) The struggles of the ricksha coolies will bring about a
direct conflict not only with the Kuomintang Government
but also with the imperialistic Shanghai Municipal Council.

(d) Every year thousands of ricksha coolies are being forcibly
conscripted by Kuomintang warlords to fill the Kuomintang
armies. On this account, this will serve us as the best
means to conduct our anti-militarist work and anti-5th
Red suppression campaign among the Kuomintang forces.

The labour union should first of all go among ricksha
coolies in order to understand existing conditions. Then the
union should prepare short and clear principles of demands
and struggles for the ricksha coolies. Such principles
should include the following points :-

(a) They should be brief; they should reveal vividly the
distressful conditions of ricksha coolies and indicate
the persons responsible for their plight.

(b) They should give a clear analysis of the suggestions
recently made by the Shanghai Municipal Council, the
French Municipal Council and the Chinese City Government
(see the recommendations of the Ricksha Committee recently
published by the S.M.C.) and also of the more unreasonable
demands which the Ricksha owners are going to submit. They
should expose the absurdity of the so-called "improvement"
plan of the S.M.C. and the quarrel between the Settlement
Authorities and the Chinese Government over a share in the
profits.

(c) They should clearly disclose the "pacific" protest lodged
by the Yellow Labour Union with the S.M.C., the Chinese
Government and the ricksha owners and other forms of
deceit.

(d) They should embody the fundamental demands of the ricksha
coolies.

(e) They should point out ways by means of which the demands
could be realized.

工会在黄包车夫中拟开展的活动草案。

虽然人力车运输不是一个具有任何战斗意义的工业企业，但在考虑组织黄包车夫并指导其斗争的问题时，对于革命工会而言至关重要。

这可以基于以下理由解释：-

(a) 上海有近 10 万名黄包车夫。

(b) 其中，60% 是来自农村地区的贫农和劳工，他们每年春夏季必须返回江苏西北部的农村地区。我们在他们中间的工作构成了工业无产阶级与农民之间最重要的纽带。我们应该尽力利用这一纽带来发展我们在农村地区革命群众中的工作。上海约 25% 的黄包车夫是被解雇的工厂工人，他们在在职和失业工人之间保持着非常好的关系。通过这一点，我们的工会可以建立许多联系。

(c) 黄包车夫的斗争不仅会与国民党政府发生直接冲突，也会与帝国主义的上海公共租界工部局发生直接冲突。

(d) 每年有成千上万的黄包车夫被国民党军阀强行征召入伍，填补国民党军队。因此，这将作为我们在国民党军队中开展反军阀工作和反第五次围剿工作的最佳手段。

工会首先应深入黄包车夫中以了解现状。然后，工会应为黄包车夫准备简短明确的诉求和斗争原则。这些原则应包括以下几点：-

(a) 它们应当简明扼要；应当生动地揭示黄包车夫的悲惨处境，并指出造成其困境的责任人。

(b) 它们应当对上海公共租界工部局、法公董局和中国市政府最近提出的建议（参见工部局最近发布的黄包车委员会的建议）以及黄包车车主即将提出的更不合理的要求进行清晰分析。它们应当揭露工部局所谓“改善”计划的荒谬性，以及租界当局与中国政府之间关于利润分成问题的争吵。

(c) 它们应当清楚地披露黄色工会向工部局、中国政府和黄包车车主提出的“和平”抗议以及其他形式的欺骗行为。

(d) 它们应当体现黄包车夫的基本诉求。

(e) 它们应当指出实现这些诉求的途径。

The following are the demands of the ricksha
coolies :-

(1) That the rental of a public ricksha for 24 hours should
not exceed 50 cents small money; that the rental should
be calculated proportionately in case the ricksha has
been hired for less than 24 hours; that coolies should
be guaranteed an earning of not less than 50 cents big
money a day; that if the earnings of a coolie do not
reach this amount, then the rental of the ricksha for
the day should not exceed one-third of the total
earnings of the coolie.

(2) That all fines imposed for contravention of regulations
be defrayed by the ricksha companies or foremen and that
the assaulting of coolies, the seizing of cushions and
licences by policemen be stopped.

(3) That a rice allowance of 10 cents big money be deducted
every day from the payments to ricksha companies and/or
foremen.

(4) That all debts as well as interest due by coolies to
ricksha companies and/or foremen be abolished; that the
deposit money, clothing money, fines, etc. be cancelled,
and that no coolie be dismissed for failure to pay his
ricksha hire, or debt or fine, etc.

(5) That the ricksha company and/or foremen should issue a
daily allowance of not less than 20 cents big money
and also medical expenses to coolie in case he is sick
or some accident befalls him; that the ricksha company
defray funeral expenses of a coolie and issue a
compassionate grant of $50 to the family of the deceased;
that five hospitals to provide for free medical treatment
of coolies and their families be established in the
International Settlement, the French Concession, Chapei,
Western District and Nantao, and that the expenses for
the upkeep of these institutions be borne by ricksha
company proprietors and the civic authorities of the
Chinese Territory and Foreign Settlements in Shanghai.

(6) That repairs to rickshas, regardless of the cause of
damage, be carried out by the ricksha company and/or
foremen.

(7) That ricksha companies and/or foremen issue periodically
and free of charge blue coloured and durable uniforms,
warm clothing, raincoats, caps and shoes.

(8) That ricksha companies erect huts for the accommodation
of coolies and their families and that free bedding be
issued to every coolie.

(9) That ricksha companies and civic authorities establish
schools for the free education of the children of the
coolies.

(10) That the system of restricting the parking of rickshas
be abolished.

(11) That the stipulation of the authorities of the
International Settlement, French Concession and
Chinese Territory to reduce the number of rickshas
be opposed.

以下是黄包车夫的要求：-

(1) 公共黄包车24小时的租金不得超过小洋5角；如果租车时间不足24小时，租金应按比例计算；保证车夫每日收入不少于大洋5角；如果车夫的收入未达到此数额，则当日黄包车租金不得超过车夫总收入的三分之一。

(2) 所有因违反规章而处以的罚款应由黄包车公司或包工头支付；停止警察殴打车夫、扣押坐垫和执照的行为。

(3) 每日从支付给黄包车公司及/或包工头的款项中扣除大洋1角作为米贴。

(4) 废除车夫欠黄包车公司及/或包工头的所有债务及利息；取消押金、服装费、罚款等；不得因车夫未能支付车租、债务或罚款等而将其解雇。

(5) 黄包车公司及/或包工头应向车夫发放每日不少于大洋2角的津贴，并在车夫生病或遭遇事故时支付医疗费用；黄包车公司应承担车夫的丧葬费用，并向死者家属发放50美元的抚恤金；在公共租界、法租界、闸北、西区及南市设立五所医院，为车夫及其家属提供免费医疗服务，这些机构的维持费用由黄包车公司业主以及上海华界和外国租界的市政当局承担。

(6) 无论损坏原因如何，黄包车的修理工作均应由黄包车公司及/或包工头负责。

(7) 黄包车公司及/或包工头应定期免费发放耐用蓝色制服、保暖衣物、雨衣、帽子和鞋子。

(8) 黄包车公司应搭建棚屋以供车夫及其家属居住，并向每位车夫免费提供寝具。

(9) 黄包车公司和市政当局应建立学校，为车夫子女提供免费教育。

(10) 废除限制黄包车停放的制度。

(11) 反对公共租界、法租界和华界当局关于减少黄包车数量的规定。

------------------------------------
(1) Name: Den Hui; alias 史文光
(2) Age: 27.
(3) Nativity: Ping You Hsien (平榆县), Shansi.
(4) Family standing: My family belongs to the bourgeois class. My
father was a shop assistant and is at present staying at home.
I have one older and one younger brother. They are all merchants;
the former being a cloth pedlar (with a capital of 2,000), while
the latter is a cloth shop assistant. We have about 180 mow of
lean soil (worth about $5 a mow), which is ploughed by farm hands.
Several years ago the income from the land exceeded our living
expenses, but nowadays we are on the verge of bankruptcy.
(5) Profession: I studied in the Peking University for 3 years
and was expelled. Later, I was employed as teacher in a
middle school and in a military academy.
(6) Place and date of joining the Party and the introducer:
I joined the Party through the recommendation of Liu Seong Yoong
(刘松云) in January, 1932. (This man Liu has at present lost
connection with the Party owing to illness.)
(7) Positions occupied since joining the Party: Clerk of the
District Committee of the Anti-Imperialist League; Chief
Secretary to the Hopei Provincial Committee of the Anti-Imperialist
League; transferred to Shansi in February, 1933, and appointed
Secretary to the Propaganda Department of the Shansi Special
District Committee.
(8) Mistakes and punishment: Nil.
(9) Ever been arrested?- I was arrested once while engaged in
propaganda work, but was soon released owing to lack of evidence.
(10) Educational Standard: University education.
(11) Dialects spoken: I can speak Shansi, Peiping and Hopei
dialects as well as English.
(12) Any speciality: Leather making.

(4) 家庭状况：我家属于资产阶级阶层。我父亲曾是店员，目前在家闲居。我有一个哥哥和一个弟弟。他们都是商人；前者是布贩（资本2,000元），后者是布店店员。我们拥有约180亩贫瘠土地（每亩价值约5美元），由雇农耕种。几年前，土地收入超过我们的生活开支，但如今我们已濒临破产。
(5) 职业：我在北京大学学习了3年并被开除。后来，我在一所中学和一所军校担任教师。
(6) 入党地点、日期及介绍人：我于1932年1月经刘松云（Liu Seong Yoong）介绍入党。（此人刘目前因病与党失去联系。）
(7) 入党后担任的职务：反帝同盟区委员会书记员；反帝同盟河北省委员会首席秘书；1933年2月调往山西，任反帝同盟山西特别区委员会宣传部秘书。
(8) 错误及处分：无。
(9) 是否曾被捕？- 我在从事宣传工作时曾被捕一次，但因证据不足很快获释。
(10) 教育程度：大学学历。
(11) 所讲方言：我会说山西话、北平话和河北话，以及英语。
(12) 特长：皮革制作。

Report of the Panshih Central Union Committee
To the Manchurian Provincial Committee.
I. The 3rd anti- encirclement Campaign of the Japanese imperialism and its puppet manchukuo in south manchuria and the favourable establishment of our united front in the destruction of their campaign :

1. The Japanese imperialism with its lackey manchukuo began the offensive against us on December 1, using the military strength of about 2,000 men to attack our forces by two routes. The first route is that the enemies used the Kirin-Hailun Railway as their centre like in North Panahih ste, while the 2nd Route is to use Hsanyang, west Panshih, etc. as a base for an operation against our troops. The main force of the enemies to fight us is the 2nd Teaching corps (now is re-organized into the anti-Red Partisan Force) numbering between 700 and 800 men, the 14th regiment and the Logone Force. In the beginning of the campaign of the Japanese imperialists, the 5th Company of the Logone Force on Dec. 6 conducted a heroic meeting under our leadership, administering a crushing blow to the 3rd offensive of the Japanese-man-chukuo bandits, causing the enemies a shocking surprise.

In the course of the offensive, the fierce measures taken by the enemies are : 1) they employed their small units to fight us by means of the partisan fighting tactics. For instance, when meeting with our anti-Japanese forces, the enemies hand in hand with the other units begin fighting by surrounding us. Sometimes, they storm us at night. In all times, they arrested and butchered the anti-Japanese masses and our comrades in particular. 2) Not only were they resorting to the cruel bombardments, the setting fire to houses and countries, the arrests, the slaughter, the assailing of women, etc. but as well they employed various kinds of the reformist methods like the distribution of handbills, etc. causing the masses to wander away from us. 3) they positively bought and guided the renegades, landlords, gentries, etc., enforced the mutual guarantee system, and forced to put the laws of the Manchukuo into operation, in hopes of consolidating the regime of the Manchukuo in the villages in breaking the organizations of the revolutionary masses. 4) they positively disarmed those troops that, capitulating to the Manchukuo before, are regarded by them as unreliable and untrustworthy forces. At the same time, they prosecuted the "lean-up" campaign in the Manchukuo troops in the forms of the re-organization, disbandment, dismissals and shootings. 5) they innumerably paralysed the revolutionary united front between the Chinese and the Korean toiling masses. For example, the Japanese militarists used their Korean agents to slaughter the Chinese masses, on the one hand and made rumours that the leaders of the red army are Korean on the other.

2) During the course of this anti-Rede Campaign, the various anti-Japanese forces and volunteers have decreased by 2/3 in their numbers. (For instance, the regiment under xx has now only 130 men left.), but

磐石中心_union_委员会给满洲省委的报告。
一、日本帝国主义及其傀儡满洲国在南满发动的第三次“围剿”战役，以及我们在粉碎其战役中建立统一战线的有利条件：

1. 日本帝国主义与其走狗满洲国于12月1日开始向我们发动进攻，动用约2,000人的军事力量分两路攻击我军。第一路敌人以吉林-海伦铁路为中心，如同在北盘石（North Panahih ste）地区一样；第二路则以三阳（Hsanyang）、西磐石等地为基地，对我军进行作战。敌军与我军作战的主力是第2教导团（现已重组为反红游击队），人数在700至800人之间，以及第14团和罗贡（Logone）部队。在日本帝国主义战役初期，罗贡部队第5连于12月6日在我们领导下举行了一次英勇的集会，对日满匪徒的第三次进攻给予了沉重打击，令敌人震惊不已。

在进攻过程中，敌人采取的严厉措施有：1) 他们利用小分队，采取游击战术与我们作战。例如，当遇到我们的抗日部队时，敌人与其他部队联手，通过包围我们开始战斗。有时，他们在夜间袭击我们。他们始终逮捕并屠杀抗日群众，特别是我们的同志。2) 他们不仅采取残酷的轰炸、焚烧房屋和乡村、逮捕、屠杀、侮辱妇女等手段，还采用各种改良主义方法，如散发传单等，致使群众远离我们。3) 他们积极收买和引导叛徒、地主、绅士等，实施连保制度，并强制推行满洲国法律，希望通过破坏革命群众的组织来巩固满洲国在农村的政权。4) 他们积极解除那些此前已向满洲国投降、被其视为不可靠和不信任的部队的武装。同时，他们以重组、解散、免职和枪决等形式，在满洲国军队中开展“清理”运动。5) 他们无数次地瘫痪中韩劳苦大众之间的革命统一战线。例如，日本军国主义者一方面利用其朝鲜代理人屠杀中国群众，另一方面散布谣言称红军领导人是朝鲜人。

2) 在这次反红战役过程中，各种抗日力量和志愿军的人数减少了三分之二。（例如，xx旗下的团现在仅剩130人。）但是

page_data.en:
Page 2

there has been a considerable increase in their determination
to fight wars against Japan, as well as in their confidence
in our leadership. For instance, the volunteers and partisans
willingly made activities with our forces in one place,
reluctantly leaving us for other places.

Our army led to Xiangnang a corps of the soldiers
who broke out in mutiny on Oct.6. According to a recent
letter from Xiangnang, we have under our leadership the
anti-Japanese army of about 400 men.

3) Under such policies as the re-organization, disarmament,
etc., taken by Japan, the wave of the anti-Japanese mutinies
of the Manchukuo soldiers and especially those Manchukuo
troops that are under the influence of our party and army
is steadily growing. The prestiges and influences of our party
and army are greatly developing and raising among the
Manchukuo soldiers. For instance, a unit of the Manchukuo
troop spontaneously offered to uprising before us and when
our 1st Regiment fought the Manchukuo troop from without
this unit then began to go on mutiny. Due to the mistake in
our leadership, scores of mutineers ran away with arms but now
there are only 4 mutineers, over 10 rifles and 3 horses left
in our corps.

At present soldiers in various Manchukuo forces urgently
want to break out in mutiny but, unfortunately, we're not able
to penetrate into the Manchukuo troops in bravely leading
the heroic revolt of the Manchukuo soldiers for the sake of
lack of cadres.

4) Under the most barbaric slaughtering and exploiting policy
that the Japanese imperialism pursued, the sentiment of workers,
peasants and toilers for the struggle against Japan and against
the Manchukuo is higher and higher. They show the extra-
ordinarily warm welcome and protection to the victory of our
army over the Japanese-Manchukuo troops.

The above facts prove that the Reds Suppression Campaign
of the Japanese Manchukuo bandits not only failed to suppress
the anti-Japanese revolutionary war in South Manchuria but on
the contrary engendered the consciousness and fighting
determination of the broader anti-Japanese masses, leading
to the condition favourable to the united front of revolution.

II. Our victory and loss during the course of our destruction
of the enemy offensive :

1. (1) We led the mutiny of the 8th Company of the Legong
Force (one of the main forces to fight us), dealing a smashing
blow to this anti-Reds campaign of the enemies. (2) Our
first Regiment guided the anti-Japanese army of about
400 men in Xiangnang in extending the partisan districts
and consolidating the united front against Japan. (3) Our
headquarter developed the partisan districts in South
Manchukuo, enlarging the anti-Japanese armies, and propa-
gandizing and organizing after the leader masses (but due to our
poor work, the large masses are not yet clear about the
correct proposals of our party). (4) Our 1st Company and
Youth Battalion led the anti-Japanese army of about 80
men in Panshik.
page_data.zh:
第2页

他们对抗日作战的决心以及对我们要领导的信心已大大增强。例如，志愿者和游击队员愿意在一处与我军协同行动，而不愿离开我们去往他处。

我军率领了10月6日发生哗变的香南（Xiangnang，音译）部队士兵。根据香南最近来信，在我方领导下，有一支约400人的抗日军队。

3) 在日本采取重组、解除武装等政策下，伪满洲国士兵的反日哗变浪潮，尤其是受我党和军队影响的那些伪满部队的哗变浪潮，正在稳步增长。我党和军队在伪满士兵中的威望和影响力正在极大发展和提升。例如，一支伪满部队自发地在我们面前起义，当我军第一团从外部与伪满部队交战时，该部随即开始哗变。由于我方领导失误，数十名哗变者携械逃跑，但目前我军中仅剩4名哗变者、十余支步枪和3匹马。

目前，各伪满部队士兵迫切希望发动哗变，但不幸的是，由于缺乏干部，我们无法深入伪满部队，勇敢领导伪满士兵的英雄起义。

4) 在日本帝国主义推行最野蛮的屠杀和剥削政策下，工人、农民和劳苦大众对抗日及反伪满洲国斗争的情绪日益高涨。他们对我军战胜日伪部队表示极其热烈的欢迎和保护。

上述事实证明，日伪匪徒的“剿赤”运动不仅未能镇压南满的抗日革命战争，反而激发了更广大抗日群众的意识和战斗决心，形成了有利于革命统一战线的条件。

二、我们在粉碎敌人进攻过程中的胜利与损失：

1. (1) 我们策动了乐宫（Legong，音译）部队（攻击我军的主力之一）第八连的哗变，给敌人的反共战役以沉重打击。(2) 我军第一团指导香南约400人的抗日军队扩展游击区并巩固抗日统一战线。(3) 我司令部在南满发展游击区，扩大抗日军队，并在群众领袖后进行宣传和组织工作（但由于我们工作不力，广大群众尚不清楚我党的正确主张）。(4) 我军第一连和青年营率领磐石（Panshik，即磐石）约80人的抗日军队。

page_data.en:
2. Our losses: (1) On December 15, our 1st Company and Youth-Battalion in Panshih were surrounded by the Japanese Manchukuo troops with the result that over 9 fighters were sacrificed, 3 fighters were arrested and 14 rifles were wrested by the enemies. The main cause for this failure was due to the under-estimation of the enemy offensive by our leading comrades as well as because of the mistakes in our partisan fighting tactics. (2) In East Panshih accompanying the arrest of our nucleus cadres by the enemy, our organization was subject to the raid. In Itun, the masses, organized by us, were kicked out by the local enemy and our nucleus could not exist. (3) In rest Panshih, except two or three chosen comrades who continue their work, many of other comrades expressed pessimism and some of them made their escape. Not only are we unable to do work among Chinese masses at present but we cannot live in this country any long. In the conclusion of the said facts, we may say that we have many new victories in the extension of anti-Japanese war but in the partial districts of Panshih our party work, as well the mass work, is in a state of the setback and collapse instead of the development and consolidation.

III. The recent decision of the Hsien-Committee on the work.

1. Concerning the work among the Manchukuo soldiers:
The responsible comrades of the Hsien Soldiers Committee must shortly be sent to the 14th Regiment and the Legions force to recover our relation, to continue to organize the mutiny and to inspect the soldier work done by comrades in various places.

2. As to the work in the anti-Japanese forces, the Hsien Committee emphatically pointed out that the "left" phrase of the united front means in fact an opportunism of breaking the united front. In accordance with the instruction from the P.C., we should intensify to lead the partisan forces and organize the headquarter in uniting our command. Meanwhile, we should carry on our work in the forces under Wang and in the Korean Independent Regiment in pursuance of the policy of the united front.

3. As for the problem of the local parties, we must first send the local cadres to adjust and restore the organizations of the party and the masses. Capable and new cadres, must be sent to Weiman, Kingchuan, etc. (new partisan-districts) in creating our work.

4. Our work among workers of the Kirin-Hailung Railway was ceased to be carried on for a short period due to the return of comrade Chang who, not making his satisfaction for the sake of the enemy, was sacrificed during the operation after his participation in the 1st Company. Now, a cadre must be sent to this railway in adjusting our past work. We should regularly send inspectors to Sian auxiliary in helping the work because we consider that the miners in Sian will be the resources of the People's Revolutionary Army.

5. A part of the partisan force must be called back to Panshih for the purpose of wiping out the remnants of Japan and waging and moving the mass organization so as to make disturbances in the enemy rear.
page_data.zh:
2. 我方损失：(1) 12月15日，我军在磐石（Panshih，即磐石）的第一连和青年营被日伪部队包围，结果9名战士牺牲，3名战士被捕，14支步枪被敌人缴获。此次失败的主要原因在于我方领导同志低估了敌人的进攻，以及我方游击战术存在错误。(2) 在磐石东部，随着我方核心干部被敌人逮捕，我方组织遭到突袭。在伊通（Itun，即伊通），由我们组织的群众被当地敌人驱散，我方核心力量无法存续。(3) 在磐石其余地区，除两三名选定的同志继续工作外，许多其他同志表现出悲观情绪，部分人逃跑。目前我们不仅无法在中国群众中开展工作，甚至无法在该地区长期生存。综上所述，可以说我们在扩大抗日战争方面取得了很多新胜利，但在磐石的部分地区，我党的工作和群众工作处于倒退和崩溃状态，而非发展和巩固。

三、县委关于工作的近期决定。

1. 关于伪满士兵中的工作：县士兵委员会的负责同志必须尽快派往第十四团和军团部队，以恢复我方关系，继续组织哗变，并检查各地同志所做的士兵工作。

2. 关于抗日部队中的工作，县委着重指出，“左”的统一战线口号实际上意味着破坏统一战线的机会主义。根据上级党组织（P.C.）的指示，我们应加强领导游击队，并组织司令部以统一指挥。同时，我们应按照统一战线政策，在王德林（Wang，指王德林救国军）部队和朝鲜独立团中开展工作。

3. 关于地方党组织问题，我们必须首先派遣地方干部调整和恢复党及群众组织。必须向苇河（Weiman，音译，可能指苇河县或相关地区）、庆川（Kingchuan，音译）等地（新游击区）派遣能干的新干部以开创工作。

4. 由于张同志返回，我们在吉海铁路（Kirin-Hailung Railway）工人中的工作曾短暂停止。张同志因不满敌人而在参加第一连后的行动中牺牲。现在，必须派遣一名干部到该铁路调整我们过去的工作。鉴于我们认为西安（Sian，即西安煤矿，今辽源）矿工是人民革命军的资源，我们应定期派遣巡视员协助西安方面的工作。

5. 必须召回部分游击队力量前往磐石，目的是消灭日寇残余势力，发动和组织群众运动，以便在敌人后方制造混乱。

II Concerning the problem of the Hsien-Committee itself :

Its leadership is very weak due to the fact that comrade
Liu was sacrificed comrade Chang deserted, a peasant comrade
did not take part in any practical work, and a worker-
comrade also did not do any work. Now, the H.C. has only
one secretary left.

V. Our demands :

1. In order to examine our work, in order to settle the
whole of the organizational problem and in order to guide
our work, you should send an inspector.

2. We demand you to send several cadres in assuming the
work of the secretary and the propaganda department.

3. Please tell us our organizational relation in the 2nd
Teaching Corps if you know because this corps is one of the main
main forces of the enemies to fight us.

The Central Hsien Committee of
Pannih.
Dec. 30, 1933.

二、关于县委自身的问题：

其领导非常薄弱，原因是刘同志牺牲，张同志叛逃，一名农民同志未参与任何实际工作，一名工人同志也未做任何工作。目前，县委仅剩一名书记。

五、我们的要求：

1. 为了检查我们的工作，解决整个组织问题并指导我们的工作，你们应派遣一名巡视员。

2. 我们要求你们派遣几名干部担任书记和宣传部的工作。

3. 如果你们知道，请告知我们在第二教导团中的组织关系，因为该团是敌人攻击我军的主力之一。

磐石中心县委
1933年12月30日

3. From June to Sept., the Hsien Committee inspected
three times the nuclei, sending the instructions and
letters twice to various nuclei per month.

4. A 5-day training class was opened once.

5. On Sept. 18, about 150 comrades and 3,500 toilers were
mobilized in holding the mass meeting and conducting
the demonstration.

II. The existing situation from Sept. 18 to the end of Dec.:

1. Concerning the party: The railway nucleus has 6 cells
with 21 comrades. In Northern Panshih there are 3
nuclei with 20 comrades. In Polcho there are 2 nuclei
with 7 comrades. In xx there is a special nucleus with
6 comrades (3 Korean). In xx there is a special nucleus
with 10 comrades (6 Korean). In Eastern Panshih, the
nucleus comrades have now lost their relation with us
following the arrest of the nucleus-secretary.

No report is available from the People's revolutionary
army. But we are sure that it must have a more development
than before. In the 14th Regiment, 3 new members have
been drawn into our party and there is a prospect of the
growth in our organization.

Under the circumstance of the enemy military campaign
against us, our village-nuclei can only maintain their
present condition and the work of the nucleus comrades
in extremely weak.

Turning to the work of the special nucleus in the Siam
coal-mine, the party still does not send its inspector in
examining the work of this nucleus while the league has sent
an inspector.

2. As to the mass bodies :

Many anti-Japanese organizations, the peasants
committee, etc. in various parts of Panshih, under the
oppression of the Japanese-Manchukuo bandit troops
and the forces of landlords, are now ceasing to carry out
their tasks.

Recently, the Hsien Committee has dispatched an
inspector to examine the work in the railway nucleus,
resulting in not only finding old comrades who lost
the party relation but absorbing a number of new members
into the party. Meanwhile, about 80 railway workers
under the leadership of our comrades are now prepared to
go on strike, the object of which is 1) to oppose the
meals provided by foremen but demand by themselves;
2) to protest against the dismissal, 3) to reduce the
working hours, etc.

3. As having said that the Hsien Committee is not healthy,
we quite hope you to send before especially a comrade
able to assume the work of the organization department.
At the present time when the masses spontaneously wage
the struggles in various places, we consider profoundly
that the work to foster the cadres is one of the most
urgent tasks.

Report from Tangshan

I. The situation in various mines in Tangshan : There are
5 mines in Tangshan. The 5 mines are divided into two
kinds, namely, the internal mine and the external mine.

1. The number of workers and their "Bankow" (regional)
idea: According to the information made by the yellow
trade union, the employed miners number no less than 10,000
while the miners thrown on the street are about 2,000 in
number.
The mining workers are for the most part the ruined
peasants and small sections of them are rascals. The
life of the bulk of workers is rascalization. Their
regional notion is heavy a good deal. They are divided up
the Tangshanese, the Shantungese, etc.
The heaviness of the regional conception among workers
always affords the facility to capitalists to shatter the
influence of workers, causing workers not to consolidate them-
selves together. At the same time, the regional conception
is utilized by the yellow trade union leaders as a weapon
to capture the higher position. For instance, in the
year before last year, a yellow leader (Pootingese), by
using the regional conflict, called on his countrymen,
the Teholese, etc. to oust another yellow leader (Tangagese)
by declaring the crimes of the latter that the latter embezzled
the public funds of the yellow union and deducted the wages
of workers etc. while the latter appealed to the Tamingese
etc. take up the cudgels against the former. As a result
the workers in the two factions contributed money to their
respective wings for the funds of the petition. In August
last, the same event took place and the workers on two sides
fought each other with stones, sticks and even pistol,
resulting in that workers donated money for the expenses of
going to the court.

2. The working hour ranged from 8 to 18 a day in various
mines. Sometimes, various departments of the mines
employed the jobbers. The wages of workers ranged from
30 to 70 cents per day.

3. The capitalists employed various forms and methods to
exploit the workers. The exploitation may be divided into
two kinds, namely, the direct and the indirect. The direct
exploitation is to want workers to take photo and to have
name place. Otherwise, it is difficult to go to work
in the mines. If discovered by the management that the
photo or the name places are false, the workers must be
deprived of their bonus and even dismissed, and if they are
injured or killed during operation, no pension be paid by
capitalists to them. If one having a name-place and
having taken a photo is wounded or killed, about $500 be
paid as pension to him by capitalists. The other method to
exploit workers is to deduct their wages for the festival
expenses. For instance, the wages of workers is deducted
for the funds in performing the theatre on May Day. The
indirect method to squeeze the workers is that the contractors
and the yellow trade union force the workers to pay the
membership due, beating workers, watching their actions, etc.

唐山报告

一、唐山各矿情况：唐山有5个矿井。这5个矿井分为两类，即内矿和外矿。

1. 工人人数及其“帮口”（地域）观念：根据黄色工会提供的信息，受雇矿工不少于一万人，而流落街头的矿工约有二千人。
矿工大多是破产农民，其中一小部分是流氓无产者。大多数工人的生活呈现流氓化特征。他们的地域观念相当重。他们分为唐山人、山东人等派系。
工人中浓厚的地域观念总是为资本家破坏工人的影响力提供便利，导致工人无法团结在一起。同时，黄色工会领袖利用地域观念作为争夺高位的武器。例如，在前年，一名黄色工会领袖（保定籍），利用地域冲突，号召其同乡德州人等驱逐另一名黄色工会领袖（唐山籍），宣称后者犯有侵吞黄色工会公款和克扣工人工资等罪行，而后者则呼吁大名府人等拿起棍棒对抗前者。结果，两派工人为各自的派系捐款作为请愿资金。去年八月，类似事件再次发生，双方工人用石头、棍棒甚至手枪互殴，导致工人们捐款支付诉讼费用。

2. 各矿的工作时间每天从8小时到18小时不等。有时，矿山的各个部门雇佣包工头。工人的工资每天在30到70美分之间。

3. 资本家采用各种形式和方法剥削工人。剥削可分为两种，即直接剥削和间接剥削。直接剥削是要求工人拍照并登记姓名住址。否则，很难进入矿山工作。如果管理层发现照片或姓名住址造假，工人将被剥夺奖金甚至被解雇，如果在作业中受伤或死亡，资本家不向他们支付任何抚恤金。如果一名已登记姓名住址并拍了照的工人受伤或死亡，资本家会支付约500美元作为抚恤金。另一种剥削工人的方法是从工资中扣除节日费用。例如，从工人工资中扣除五一节演戏的资金。间接压榨工人的方法是，包工头和黄色工会强迫工人缴纳会费，殴打工人，监视他们的行动等。

page_data.en:
4. Following their occupation of Tangshan, the Japanese imperialists and capitalists intensified their exploitation and oppression against workers by suspending two-days work per week, doing away with the contract made formerly between workers and capitalists, allowing no workers to stop their work, abolishing the yellow trade union, etc.
Aside from sucking the blood and sweat of workers by using the above methods, the Japanese imperialists opened many gambling houses, opium dens, etc. for the purpose of squeezing the workers on the one hand and watching the movement of workers on the other. At the same time, they organized the Japanese Society in which workers are induced to join with payment of two dollars as membership due and to be nationalized in Japan, forming the so-called "National-Salvation-Army" that is ordered to shift for itself in the local places, ransacking indiscriminately the countrysides.

5) Subject to the cruel exploitation and persecution on the part of the Japanese imperialism, the workers and peasants hated and detested it bitterly. In June, the miners looted the Japanese treasury and organs, killing a Japanese. In XX, the workers ransacked the Japanese treasury, resulting in the arrest of 12 workers, 5 policemen and one officer (some were fined by one hundred dollars and some were sentenced to 12 years' imprisonment).
Meanwhile, in the villages, the peasants arrested the officers and soldiers of the so-called national-salvation-army as soon as seeing them, burying them alive. Some of villages held up the motor-cars of the Japanese troops.

6) The accounts of the past struggles and the present demands of workers: When waging the struggle for the payment of bonus, the workers bravely surrounded by management.
The struggles, against the deduction of wages, for the increased pay, against the yellow leaders, etc. resulted in success.
The influence of the party has penetrated into the workers of various mines. Especially during the past victorious struggles, the majority of workers knew that the C.C. is brave and fights for the interests of workers. Scores of workers said that "the struggles are not successful were they not led by the C.P."
Following the outbreak of the Kalgan event, the workers said "Chiang Kai-shek co-operated with Japan to the C.P. in Kalgan". Some said "The method of the C.P. to mete out the food of landlords and rich men to the poor people is correct". But they considered that the communists are the returned students from abroad and that the workers have no qualification to join the C.P.
The present demands of workers are: (1) to abolish the two-days' suspension of work in a week; (2) to put the previous contract into operation and to increase wages; (3) to oppose the dismissal; (3) to set up the trade union; etc. However, the workers in general considered it impossible to go on strike at present, saying that if we declare the walkout we must have no food to eat because the capitalists would soon carry on the lockout due to the fact that the coal are not yet sold out. They proposed that they lay down their tools and go on strike as soon as the coals are sold for the capitalists will certainly comply with our demands at that time when we conduct the strike. As considering it difficult to go on strike without the trade union, the workers are anxious to form their trade union.
page_data.zh:
4. 日本帝国主义者和资本家占领唐山后，通过实行每周停工两天、废除以前工人与资本家签订的合同、禁止工人停工、取缔黄色工会等手段，加剧了对工人的剥削和压迫。
除了使用上述手段榨取工人的血汗外，日本帝国主义者还开设了许多赌场、鸦片馆等，一方面是为了压榨工人，另一方面是为了监视工人的动向。同时，他们组织了“日本协会”，诱导工人加入，缴纳两美元作为会费，并入日本国籍，组建所谓的“救国军”，该部队被命令在当地自谋生路， indiscriminately（ indiscriminately 意为不加区分地，此处依语境译为肆意）洗劫乡村。

5) 遭受日本帝国主义的残酷剥削和迫害，工农群众对其恨之入骨。六月，矿工抢劫了日本的国库和机关，杀死了一名日本人。在 XX（原文不清），工人抢劫了日本国库，导致12名工人、5名警察和一名军官被捕（有些人被罚款一百美元，有些人被判处12年监禁）。
与此同时，在农村，农民一看到所谓的“救国军”官兵就将其逮捕，活埋。一些村庄还拦截了日军的汽车。

6) 过去的斗争情况及工人的当前要求：在为发放奖金而进行的斗争中，工人们勇敢地包围了管理层。
反对克扣工资、要求增加工资、反对黄色工会领袖等斗争取得了成功。
党的影响已经渗透到各矿工人中。特别是在过去胜利的斗争中，大多数工人知道共产党（C.C. 此处应指 Communist Party，即共产党）勇敢并为工人利益而战。数十名工人说：“如果没有共产党的领导，斗争就不会成功。”
张家口事件爆发后，工人们说：“蒋介石在张家口与日本合作反对共产党”。有人说：“共产党将地主和富人的粮食分给穷人的方法是正确的”。但他们认为共产党人是归国留学生，工人没有资格加入共产党。
工人的当前要求是：(1) 废除每周停工两天的规定；(2) 恢复执行以前的合同并增加工资；(3) 反对解雇；(3) 建立工会；等等。然而，工人们普遍认为目前不可能罢工，他们说，如果我们宣布罢工，我们就没饭吃，因为煤炭尚未售罄，资本家很快就会实行闭厂。他们提议，一旦煤炭售罄，他们就放下工具罢工，因为那时我们举行罢工，资本家肯定会答应我们的要求。鉴于没有工会很难罢工，工人们急于组建自己的工会。

7)    The number of the unemployed workers must not be
2,000 for the dismissal of workers by batches is daily
occurrence.    Furthermore, the wrecked peasants flocked into
the industrial regions and cities, causing the employed
workers to sustain the further exploitation of the capitalist.

II.  The situation about the party organization:

    In the course of the loss of its connection with the
upper party, the Tangshan party, through not enlarging its
organization in various mines, has recovered many nuclei.
At the same time, every comrade took part in the production,
penetrating into the masses in comprehending their life
and establishing our new contact with them, and especially
displaying our party leadership in the factions of workers.

1)    There are 4 nuclei with 18 comrades (one woman-comrade)
the composition of whom is: 13 workers, 3 unemployed workers,
1 teacher of the primary school and 1 petty merchant.

2)    The life of various nuclei is far from healthy.
Though the lack of the organizational work, comrades can carry
on the propaganda and agitation work.

3) The mass organisation
    There are 3 members of the Saving Country Society, 3
members of the Friends of the Red Army and 60 members in the
Fighting Society of the Daiming-Guild in which our party leadership
has been set up.    We now intend to convert the members of the
Fighting-Society into the pickets.

4) The propaganda work:    In addition to making oral propaganda
work, the Tangshan party published a small paper which played a
relative role among the masses for it could be openly read by
them.

7)    失业工人人数肯定不止2,000人，因为成批解雇工人是每日发生的事。此外，破产农民涌入工业地区和城市，导致在职工人遭受资本家进一步的剥削。

二、党组织情况：

    在与上级党组织失去联系的过程中，唐山党组织虽然没有在各矿扩大组织，但恢复了许多核心小组。同时，每位同志都参加生产，深入群众，了解他们的生活，并与他们建立新的联系，特别是在工人派系中展现我们党的领导作用。

1)    有4个核心小组，共18名同志（其中一名女同志），其构成为：13名工人，3名失业工人，1名小学教师和1名小商人。

2)    各核心小组的生活远非健康状态。尽管缺乏组织工作，同志们仍能开展宣传和鼓动工作。

3) 群众组织
    有3名救国会成员，3名红军之友成员，以及大名府公会奋斗社的60名成员，我们在其中建立了党的领导。我们现在打算将奋斗社的成员转化为纠察队。

4) 宣传工作：除了进行口头宣传外，唐山党组织还出版了一份小报，由于群众可以公开阅读，它在群众中发挥了一定的作用。

January 15, 1934.

Report from the Hailung Party to the Manchurian
Provincial Committee

I. Concerning the problem of the organisation:

1. You should strengthen the Panshih Hsien Committee,
causing it to regularly inspect the work in Hailung,
Fengtien.

2. If possible, you should send a standing inspector to
South Manchuria for the purpose of examining and directing
our work.

3. The Special Committee of South Manchuria must be shortly
set up if possible.

II. Concerning our work :

1. Following the conclusion of the 3rd meeting of the
Executive Committee, 3 new comrades have been drawn into
our party, and 30 toilers have been organized into the
mass body. About $100 were raised from the masses in
support of the People's Revolutionary Army. No reports
are received from two Hsiens (Shian and Fengfeng).

III. As to the activities of the People's R. A.:

Since the attack on Shanyuanpoo, the P.R.A., on Dec. 23,
launched an attack upon a village in Hewhe Hsien. In
the course of this movement, a Japanese agent was killed,
2 Chinese agents (masters of the Tax-Collecting Bureau
and the Telephone) were captured and about 100 houses of
agents were set on fire by the P.R.A. After that, the
P.R.A., in conjunction with a unit of volunteers (about
700 men), advanced towards Linkiang with the main object
of joining hands with the other units of the anti-Japanese
forces. Our partisan company and a section of the 9th
Company made their activities in Shanyuang etc., arresting
of late 2 Korean lackeys of Japan, promising to free them on
ransom. According to a report from Panshih, a Regiment of
the Manchukuo troops going on mutiny, the volunteers under
XX and a unit under XX were incorporated into the People's
Revolutionary Army.

IV. The influence of the P.R.A. is great among the volunteers.
They said: "The P.R.A. is the real troop to save the
country and we should follow it to do". The masses in the
partisan districts said that they never saw the good troop
like the P.R.A. They asked the P.R.A. to partisanize in
their regions, saying that they should protect the P.R.A.
in all means supplying it with food and informing it
of the whereabouts of the enemies.

V. The anti-Japanese sentiment of soldiers in various
places is very high. Recently, about 200 men of the
Manchukuo troops stationed in XX place broke out in mutiny.
The disarmament of the Manchukuo Troops by the Japanese
accelerated the mutiny and the anti-Japanese ferment of
soldiers.

海龙党部致满洲省委的报告

一、关于组织问题：

1. 你们应加强磐石县委员会，使其定期视察海龙、奉天的工作。

2. 如有可能，你们应向南满派遣一名常驻巡视员，以检查和指导我们的工作。

3. 南满特别委员会必须尽快成立，如果可能的话。

二、关于我们的工作：

1. 执行委员会第三次会议结束后，有3名新同志被吸收入党，30名劳动者被组织进群众团体。从群众中筹集了约100美元，以支援人民革命军。未收到来自两个县（西安和丰丰）的报告。

三、关于人民革命军的活动：

自攻击山原铺以来，人民革命军于12月23日对辉发县的一个村庄发动了攻击。在这次行动中，一名日本代理人被杀，两名中国代理人（税务局和电话局的主管）被俘，人民革命军烧毁了约100处代理人的房屋。此后，人民革命军与一支志愿军部队（约700人）联合，向临江推进，主要目的是与其他抗日部队会合。我们的游击连和第九连的一部分在山原等地开展活动，最近逮捕了两名日本的朝鲜走狗，承诺在支付赎金后释放他们。根据磐石的报告，一支伪满军队发生兵变，XX领导下的志愿军和XX领导下的一支部队被编入人民革命军。

四、人民革命军在志愿军中影响巨大。他们说：“人民革命军是真正的救国军队，我们应该跟随它行动。”游击区的群众说，他们从未见过像人民革命军这样好的军队。他们请求人民革命军在他们地区开展游击活动，并表示他们将竭尽全力保护人民革命军，为其提供粮食并通报敌人的行踪。

五、各地士兵的反日情绪非常高涨。最近，驻扎在XX地的约200名伪满军队士兵发生兵变。日军对伪满军队的缴械加速了士兵的兵变和反日情绪的发酵。

Report of the Chairman of the Front Committee.

Despite the temporary defeat it has met with as the result
the savage combined attack of Japanese Imperialism and the
Kuomintang, the betrayal of militarists and politicians in
the ranks of the Anti-Japanese Allied Forces of the people,
the disruptive activities of the Right opportunists under
the leadership of Chang Ko Tao ( ) and the political
vacillation and mistakes of the Front Committee, the mighty
Anti-Japanese and anti-imperialist revolutionary movement in
Chahar is of tremendous significance and importance for the
revolutionary movement throughout China as well as in North
China.

The revolutionary movement in Chahar broke out at the critical
juncture when Japanese imperialism was invading Peiping,
Tientsin and Chahar and when the Kuomintang Government had
signed the Tangku treaty. During this period the broad masses
of workers, peasants, soldiers and petty bourgeois of North
China were subjected to the constant danger of being slaughtered,
and being bombarded by Japanese airplanes and guns and they
were therefore fired with anti-Japanese and anti-imperialist
enthusiasm and sentiment. The open surrender of the Kuomintang
Government, cutting off the supply of anti-Japanese forces,
suppressing and dissolving the spontaneous anti-Japanese
forces of the people, launching a severe white terror against
the anti-Japanese and anti-imperialist movement served only to
sharpen the revolutionary struggle of the broad toiling masses.
Hundreds and thousands of white army soldiers revolted against
their officers and continued to carry on their war against
Japan, ( the 119th Brigade of the 41st Army and several regiments
in the Northwestern army Several thousand men of the self defence
corps of peasants in Chayong and Chifeng ( Jehol ) waged
gallant war against the Japanese invaders, while columns of
peasant armies, anti-Japanese volunteers, Student battalions,
first aid squads sprang up like mushrooms in Peiping, Tientsin
and Taiyuan. Most significant of all was the growing struggle
of workers in Tientsin and Tongshan and the peasant uprising
and partisan warfare in South Hopei.

In spite of the fact that the number of organised workers,
peasants and soldiers participating in the very commencement
of the revolutionary movement in Chahar was insignificantly
small, the toiling people of Chahar Province later on joined
the revolutionary movement in greater and greater numbers
day by day. The industrial workers of Kalgan ( Railwaymen and
electric lighting workers) quickly organised themselves and
developed class struggle, thus becoming the prop and stay
of the revolutionary movement. Peasants of such out-of-the-way
rural districts as Wanquan, Chongpei and Toloa set up their
own organisations and played a great part in the revolutionary
movement.

The wide establishment of soldiers committees and anti-Japanese
groups of soldiers in white army units ( the 2nd and 5th Divisions
the 41st Army and the Volunteer Armies) deserves special mention
The development of the revolutionary movement offered a very
strong impetus to the revolutionary struggle in Hopei, Honan
and Shensi (The creation of anti-Japanese Iron and Blood Armies
in Central and Eastern Honan, the revolt of one brigade and
one regiment of the Shensi general Feng Yu Chiang ( )
Indeed it is no exaggeration to say that the outbreak and growth

前敌委员会主席的报告。

尽管由于日本帝国主义和国民党的野蛮联合进攻、人民抗日联军内部军阀和政客的背叛、张国焘（ ）领导下的右倾机会主义者的破坏活动以及前敌委员会的政治动摇和错误，导致遭受暂时挫折，但察哈尔强大的抗日反帝革命运动对于全中国以及华北的革命运动具有巨大的意义和重要性。

察哈尔的革命运动爆发于日本帝国主义入侵北平、天津和察哈尔，且国民党政府签署《塘沽协定》的关键时刻。在此期间，华北广大工人、农民、士兵和小资产阶级民众不断面临被屠杀以及遭日本飞机和大炮轰炸的危险，因此激发了他们的抗日反帝热情和情绪。国民党政府的公开投降，切断抗日部队的补给，镇压和解散人民自发的抗日力量，对抗日反帝运动发动严厉的白色恐怖，只会加剧广大劳动群众的革命斗争。成千上万的白军士兵反抗他们的军官，继续进行对日作战，（第四十一军的第一一九旅和西北军的几个团）赤峰（热河）和朝阳的数千名农民自卫军成员英勇抗击日本侵略者，而在北平、天津和太原，农民军、抗日志愿军、学生营、急救队如雨后春笋般涌现。最重要的是天津和唐山工人斗争的增长以及冀南的农民起义和游击战。

尽管在察哈尔革命运动刚开始时，有组织参与的工人、农民和士兵数量微乎其微，但后来察哈尔省的劳动人民日益大量地加入革命运动。张家口的产业工人（铁路工人和电灯工人）迅速组织起来并开展阶级斗争，从而成为革命运动的支柱。万全、崇礼和独石口等偏远农村地区的农民建立了自己的组织，在革命运动中发挥了重要作用。

在白军部队（第二师、第五师、第四十一军和志愿军）中广泛建立士兵委员会和抗日士兵小组，值得特别提及。革命运动的发展对河北、河南和陕西的革命斗争提供了非常强大的推动力（豫中和豫东抗日铁血军的创建，陕西将军冯玉祥（ ）的一个旅和一个团的叛变）。确实，毫不夸张地说，爆发和增长

revolution ry
of the tremendous anti-Japanese and anti-imperialist/movement
in Chahar Province has played a big part not only in the anti-
Japanese and anti-imperialist fight of millions of workers
peasants and soldiers in North China, but also in the general
revolutionary movement of the Chinese toiling masses as a
whole.

11

As has already been stated in the above , the revolutionary
movement in Chahar broke out at the critical juncture when the
Japanese imperialists were invading Peiping, Tientsin and Chahar
and when the Kuomintang Government had signed the Tangku truce
treaty. It is necessary however to point out that this
revolutionary outburst was at the same time an uprising against
unbelievable oppression and exploitation by the reactionary
ruling classes. The plight and misery of the toiling masses
of Chahar is notorious and terrible. The heavy burden of taxation
nearly broke the back of the people. For example the farmer has
to pay two dollars and fifty cents in land tax for each mow, the
crop of which is hardly worth one dollar. More than ten kinds of
taxes are imposed on the transportation of agricultural produce
from the farm to the market. It need scarcely be said that
this economic background has had a good deal to do in urging the
toiling masses of Chahar along the path of the revolution.
Nevertheless we must not lose sight of the cultural backwardness
of the masses and their lack of experience in the revolutionary
movement. These two weaknesses enabled disgruntled militarists
and politicians, landlords and reactionary leaders not only to
join the revolutionary movement of the broad masses under false
colours, but also to take into their hands the leadership of the
movement. It was an open secret that their ulterior motive for
joining and controlling the revolutionary movement of the broad
toiling masses was to utilize the revolutionary enthusiasms of the
masses for gaining their private ends and enhancing their personal
power.
The Front Committee had a correct understanding of this
question. It had from the very outset waged a merciless struggle
against the opportunist line of Chang Kuo-tao, who contended that
the party must do its best to sharpen the differences among the
Kuomintang generals. For this very purpose, he suggested that the
activity of the party must not oppose Feng Yu-hsiang so that Feng
might be strong enough to fight Nanking. This was his notorious
"watermelon policy." Acting upon this policy our comrades in
the 2nd Division under the leadership of Weng Ling and Chao Chmen-
jung pursued a typical "officer line," maintaining the position of
officers at the expense of the interest of soldiers.
Unfortunately the fight against Right opportunism was limited
to the people at the top only and had not penetrated into the lower
strata, thus giving the opportunists the possibility of exerting
their influence in various forms upon some of our leading Comrades
as well as upon the rank and file and the soldier mass.
The fight against the deception of militarists and politicians
was a little bit better and satisfactory. In addition to issuing
special manifestoes on several important occasions, all the legal
papers of the party had paid the greatest attention to exposing
the disgruntled warlords and politicians in the actual questions
and clearly indicating the way out for the toiling masses. The
Front Committee had organized and guided a good number of heroic
struggles of the workers, peasants and soldiers (the struggle of
railwaymen and electric lighting works, the fight of students against
Japanese education, the self-defence movement of soldiers and their
revolt against their reactionary officers.). The monster
demonstration of thousands of workers, peasants, soldiers and
students in protest against Feng Yu-hsiang's alleged betraying the
page_data.zh:
--2--
革命性的
察哈尔省巨大的抗日反帝/运动不仅在华北数百万工人、农民和士兵的抗日反帝斗争中发挥了重要作用，而且在中国广大劳动群众的总体革命运动中也发挥了重要作用。

11

如上所述，察哈尔的革命运动爆发于日本帝国主义入侵北平、天津和察哈尔，且国民党政府签署《塘沽停战协定》的关键时刻。然而，必须指出的是，这次革命爆发同时也是对反动统治阶级令人难以置信的压迫和剥削的反抗。察哈尔劳动群众的困境和苦难是众所周知且可怕的。沉重的税收负担几乎压垮了人民。例如，农民每垧土地需缴纳两块五毛的土地税，而其收成价值 hardly 超过一美元。农产品从农场运往市场需缴纳十多种税款。毋庸赘言，这种经济背景在很大程度上促使察哈尔的劳动群众走上革命道路。然而，我们不可忽视群众的文化落后及其在革命运动中缺乏经验。这两个弱点使得不满的军阀和政客、地主和反动领袖不仅以伪装加入广大群众的革命运动，而且掌握了运动的领导权。他们加入并控制广大劳动群众革命运动的 ulterior motive（潜在动机）是利用群众的热情来谋取私利并增强个人权力，这已是一个公开的秘密。
前敌委员会对这一问题有正确的认识。它从一开始就对张国焘的机会主义路线进行了无情的斗争，张国焘主张党必须尽力加剧国民党将领之间的分歧。为此目的，他建议党的活动不得反对冯玉祥，以便冯玉祥有足够的力量对抗南京。这就是他臭名昭著的“西瓜政策”。依据这一政策，我们在翁凌和赵成荣（音译）领导下的第二师的同志奉行典型的“军官路线”，以牺牲士兵利益为代价维持军官的地位。
不幸的是，反对右倾机会主义的斗争仅限于上层人士，未能渗透到下层，从而使机会主义者有可能以各种形式对我们的一些领导同志以及普通党员和士兵群众施加影响。
揭露军阀和政客欺骗的斗争稍好一些，也令人满意。除了在几个重要场合发布特别宣言外，党的所有合法刊物都最注重在实际问题上揭露不满的军阀和政客，并明确指出劳动群众的出路。前敌委员会组织和指导了许多工人、农民和士兵的英勇斗争（铁路工人和电灯厂的斗争，学生反对日本教育的斗争，士兵的自卫运动及其对反动军官的反抗。）成千上万的工人、农民、士兵和学生举行大规模示威，抗议冯玉祥所谓的背叛

Anti-Japanese Allied Forces represented a tremendous flare-up of
the revolutionary enthusiasm of the broad masses and forced
Feng Yu-hsiang to give way. The intensification of this
movement and especially the historic campaigns for the
National-Salvation Conference of the People for North China
laid bare the deception of the reactionary elements, who had
to cast off their masks and show their true colours. They
arrested revolutionists and prohibited public meetings and
propaganda. The Front Committee at this decisive movement
could not estimate correctly the forces of the Revolution
and of the Reaction on the Bolshevist point of view and fell
into the pit of opportunism of another type by "maintaining
the existing state of affairs as long as possible so that
we may increase the revolutionary forces." In reality the
Front Committee forgot the important immediate task of
preparing and leading decisive battle with the disgruntled
warlords and political adventurers.
The lukewarm state of the fight against Right opportunism
within the party enabled the Right opportunists to hold leading
and responsible positions in some of our main forces (the
2nd Division) and to put up organized resistance to any
reconstruction in the work of the party. The Right
opportunists in the 2nd Division refused the representative
of the Front Committee participation in their leading organ.
They detained the directors and instructors of the Front
Committee without transmitting them to the rank and file.

111.

The revolutionary movement in Chahar province confronted
our party with the central tasks of leading the anti-Japanese
and anti-imperialist struggles of the workers, peasants and
soldiers; of developing the anti-Japanese partisan
movement of the broad masses and of coordinating this
growing revolutionary movement with the revolutionary struggles
of workers and peasants in Cha-Pei toward the common object
of creating new Soviet districts and Red Armies in North China.
For convenience's sake, we divide the movement into three
periods as follows:-
1. The first period begins from the outbreak of the
revolutionary coup in Chahar to the first vain attempt of
Feng Yu-hsiang at compromise. In the 1925-7 great revolution
the revolutionary struggle of the worker and peasant masses
of Kalgan was at its height. Following the defeat of the
Revolution a reign of white terror set in and the various
revolutionary mass organizations were smashed to pieces.
Nevertheless, the revolutionary struggle of workers and
peasants continued. The leadership of our party and the
organizational strength of the mass organization were weak
in the extreme. When we first came to Kalgan, we had no local
connections at all. Thanks to one month's strenuous work we
succeeded in establishing an anti-Japanese society among the
workers and students. This organization had six groups,
with a membership of 60, but it lacked revolutionary life. Later
on the Model Regiment came to Kalgan from Fengyang. We had
seventy comrades in this regiment. Sometime afterward the
troops of Feng Chen-wu and Chang Zou-chi were transferred to
Chahar and there were scattered groups of our party in these
units. The anti-Japanese and anti-imperialist feelings of
the soldiers of these army units were very high and the
influence of the Chinese Soviets and Red Armies was spreading
among them far and wide.
During this period the main tasks of the Front Committee
were to rally the broad masses of revolutionary workers,
peasants and soldiers under the flag of the Revolution, to
initiate their daily struggle against Japanese and other
imperialists and against the traitors, to unmask the disgruntled
warlords and politicians, to develop and deepen this

抗日同盟军代表了广大民众革命热情的巨大爆发，并迫使冯玉祥让步。这一运动的加强，特别是为华北人民救国会议而进行的历史性战役，揭露了反动分子的欺骗行径，他们不得不撕下伪装，露出真面目。他们逮捕革命者，禁止公众集会和宣传。前线委员会在这一决定性运动中，未能从布尔什维克的观点正确估计革命与反动的力量，陷入了另一种类型的机会主义陷阱，即“尽可能维持现状，以便我们增加革命力量”。实际上，前线委员会忘记了准备和领导对不满的军阀及政治冒险家进行决战这一重要的当前任务。

党内反对右倾机会主义斗争的不温不火状态，使得右倾机会主义者得以在我们的一些主要部队（第二师）中占据领导和负责职位，并对党的工作中的任何重组进行有组织的抵抗。第二师中的右倾机会主义者拒绝前线委员会的代表参与其领导机构。他们扣留了前线委员会的主任和指导员，未将其传达给基层官兵。

111.

察哈尔省的革命运动向我们党提出了中心任务：领导工人、农民和士兵的抗日及反帝国主义斗争；发展广大群众的抗日游击运动；并将这一日益增长的革命运动与闸北工农的革命斗争协调起来，以实现共同目标，即在华北建立新的苏维埃区和红军。为方便起见，我们将该运动分为以下三个时期：
1. 第一个时期从察哈尔革命政变爆发开始，到冯玉祥第一次徒劳的妥协尝试为止。在1925-7年的大革命期间，张家口工农群众的革命斗争达到高潮。随着革命的失败，白色恐怖统治随之而来，各种革命群众组织被粉碎。尽管如此，工农的革命斗争仍在继续。我们党的领导以及群众组织的组织力量极其薄弱。当我们初到张家口时，没有任何当地联系。得益于一个月的艰苦工作，我们成功在工人和学生中建立了一个抗日社。该组织有六个小组，成员60人，但缺乏革命活力。后来，模范团从凤阳来到张家口。我们在该团中有七十名同志。不久之后，冯占武和张作池的部队调往察哈尔，这些单位中也有我们党的分散小组。这些军队单位士兵的抗日和反帝国主义情绪非常高涨，中国苏维埃和红军的影响在他们中间广泛传播。

在此期间，前线委员会的主要任务是在革命旗帜下团结广大革命工人、农民和士兵，发起他们反对日本及其他帝国主义者和汉奸的日常斗争，揭露不满的军阀和政治家，发展并深化这一

revolutionary movement, to enlarge our party organization,
to consolidate and reorganize the leading organs of the
various party committees and to establish an independent
leadership of the party. With these tasks in view the
Front Committee concentrated its attention upon the most
important branches - the railwaymen and electric lighting
workers in Kalgan and the troops commanded by Ten Wen-yi,
Lee Chen-hai and Sun Ting-yen. The Front Committee spared
no efforts in broadening out the anti-imperialist, anti-
Japanese and anti-Kuomintang movements and in exposing the
hypnotical talk of the warlord and of the various reactionary
groups. The railwaymen in Kalgan set up their own militant
railwaymen's Union and overthrew the domination of the yellow
union and the Kuomintang office. They fought against the
exploitation by foremen, for the payment of all back wages,
for Sunday rest and for the refunding of the so-called
"patriotic tax" and "airplane tax" collected by the authorities.
The Chahar National Salvation Society had organized in its
ranks thousands of workers, peasants, soldiers, and students.
Our work in the various White army units had likewise scored
a series of achievements. Most significant of all was the
wide recruiting of soldiers into the party.
2. The second period begins from the armed attack by
the imperialist-Kuomintang bloc to the valts-free on the part of
Feng Yu-hsiang. At the beginning of this period the Anti-
Japanese Allied Forces had already increased to 50,000.
Although some of these army units were poorly equipped and
ill disciplined, yet the fact remained that revolutionary and anti
Japanese feelings of the soldier mass were very high. The
intensification of the revolutionary movement in Chahar province
was a crushing blow to the rule of the imperialists and of the
Kuomintang, which were therefore forced to act on the offensive
in every respect to check the advance of the revolution. At
that time the main forces of the Anti-Japanese Allied Army were
concentrated in Kalgan. The 41st Army under the command
of Sun Ting-yen was stationed along the railway line between
Kalgan and Hankow, while about two divisions of Shansi
troops were stationed to the west of Kalgan. In view of the
ever-growing revolutionary situation the 41st Army and the
Shansi divisions adopted a "wait-and-see" attitude, thus
rendering it extremely difficult for the Kuomintang to send
troops direct against the Anti-Japanese Allied Army. Moreover
the signing of the Tanggu treaty by the Kuomintang government
had offered a strong impetus to anti-Japanese, anti-imperialist
and anti-Kuomintang movement throughout the country, and even
the Kuomintang and the imperialists dared not carry on military
operations openly and directly against the Anti-Japanese Allied
Forces. Then they commenced their offensive first on the
political front, conducting an intensified propaganda campaign
about "Red Kalgan", "Communism and public ownership of women
in Kalgan" and so on. This lying propaganda served a double
purpose; it justified on the one hand the slaughtering of the
revolutionary toilers in Chahar by the Kuomintang generals who
were clearing the way for the dismemberment of China among the
imperialists and increased on the other hand the reactionary
activities of vacillating war-lords, politicians, landlords
and reactionaries in the ranks of the Anti-Japanese Allied Forces
who were already trembling at the radical swing of the revolution
in Chahar. It was owing these circumstances that the Christian
General made his first attempt at compromising with Nanking.
It was also under these circumstances that
the Right opportunists (Chang Kuo-tao and company) gained a
foothold in public for their capitulation "united front policy."
When Feng Yu-hsiang made his attempt at compromise

第二个时期从帝国主义-国民党集团的武装攻击开始，到冯玉祥的（原文不清）为止。在这一时期开始时，抗日同盟军已增至5万人。虽然其中一些部队装备精良程度不足且纪律涣散，但事实是，广大士兵的革命和抗日情绪非常高涨。察哈尔省革命运动的加强是对帝国主义和国民党统治的沉重打击，因此他们被迫在所有方面采取攻势，以遏制革命的推进。当时，抗日同盟军的主力集中在张家口。孙殿英指挥的第41军驻扎在张家口与汉口之间的铁路沿线，而约两个师的山西部队驻扎在张家口以西。鉴于革命形势日益增长，第41军和山西师采取了“观望”态度，这使得国民党难以直接派兵对抗抗日同盟军。此外，国民党政府签署《塘沽协定》为全国范围内的抗日、反帝和反国民党运动提供了强大的动力，甚至国民党和帝国主义也不敢公开直接对抗日同盟军进行军事行动。于是，他们首先在政治战线上发动进攻，开展关于“红色张家口”、“张家口共产主义和妇女公有”等内容的强化宣传运动。这种谎言宣传具有双重目的：一方面为国民党将军屠杀察哈尔的革命劳工提供正当理由，这些将军正在为帝国主义瓜分中国扫清道路；另一方面加剧了抗日同盟军内部摇摆不定的军阀、政治家、地主和反动分子的反动活动，这些人已经因察哈尔革命的激进转变而战栗。正是由于这些情况，基督将军（冯玉祥）首次尝试与南京妥协。也是在这种情况下，右倾机会主义者（张国涛及其同伙）为其投降主义的“统一战线政策”赢得了公开的立足点。当冯玉祥尝试妥协时
