1931年3月2日在昌平路677号查获的第116号证物译文。

闸北区委八月份拟执行的活动计划。

1. 区委各部门
a) 区委书记将负责妇女部、内部交通科、由共青团员、工会和党员召开的联席会议，并负责鸿丰、申新七厂、三新及上海第五棉纺厂的工作，
b) 组织部部长将负责失业人员、互济会及组织部执行机构。他将负责申新（？七厂）、申新九厂、永安、中钢及伟通纱厂和工厂。组织部执行机构将负责“蛋厂”、上海第二和第三棉纺厂、独轮车苦力及肥皂厂。
c) 宣传部部长将负责油印印刷以及培训和读书班。他将负责上海第一棉纺厂、新怡和、老怡和及申新五厂。
d) 失业部部长 XXXXXXXXXXXX 将负责失业委员会及其执行人员，并负责三友、宏业、酱园（？）、黄家、先施及上海第四工业工人。
失业委员会执行人员负责法租界、宋同里、宋宗及三大斗等地区。
e) 妇女部部长将负责大康、公大、伟通、申新七厂及鸿丰等工业企业的女工，以及各公共团体的妇女部、上海汇山（音译）及第一棉纺厂。
f) 油印印刷科。
g) 出版部。
h) 内部交通。

2. 罢工
1. 电力厂（？上海电力公司）的斗争
(a) 老党员应不时召开小组会议，会上应敦促每位同志就所开展的活动发表意见
(b) 加强反对黄色工会的运动。
(c) 本月吸收六名新党员入党。
(d) 扩展各种劳工团体或协会的组织。
2. 孙华毛巾厂的斗争。
(a) 扩展工人的组织。
(b) 加强反对黄色工会的活动。
(c) 区委应积极执行与斗争有关的既定措施（占领仓库，没收并拍卖其中储存的货物。）
3. 申新九棉纺厂的斗争：-
(a) 向管理层要求搬迁津贴。该厂部分机器已被搬走。
4. 申新七厂的斗争：-
派遣党组织者及其他非党员人员进入罢工群众中。
其他活动
扩展并加强群众组织。
领导工人的日常斗争。
招募新同志。
继续进行反对减少工作的斗争。

page_data.en:
-2-

5. Struggles of Hang Feeng Cotton Mill Workers against
"5 day shift" and dismissals. Preparations for
starting the above struggles have long been made but
they have not yet been carried out owing to the following
reasons:-
(1) Vacillation of comrades and their lack of hope for
victory.
(2) Lack of energy on the part of comrades.
(3) Failure to grasp opportunities when they presented
themselves.
(4) Confinement of activities to the Hunan Clique in the
factory.
(5) Neglect of activities among female workers.
(6) Neglect of activities among young workers.
(7) Subsidiary organizations being unhealthy.

Future plans to develop activities in the Hang Feeng
Mill:-
(1) Develop educational work and give the comrades
a clear conception of class struggles.
(2) Endeavour to persuade the comrades to be energetic.
(3) Organize "storming parties" to carry out activities
among Shanghai workers and female workers, and
extend the party organization.
(4) Extend the union and the anti-imperialist league
and establish branches of the Mutual Aid Society
and the Communist Youth League.
(5) Accelerate the work among female and young workers.
(6) Accelerate the movement to oppose the yellow
labour unions and the fellow countrymen's
associations.

6. Struggles in San Sing Cotton Mill:-
(1) Start struggles against dismissals; demand wages
for the period of suspension of work; and over-
throw labour traitors.
(2) Develop the party organization by absorbing
energetic elements.
(3) Develop the various organizations in the factory.

7. Struggles in Wei Tung Cotton Mills:-
(1) Establish Party Branch in one week's time.
(2) Develop and consolidate mass organizations.
(3) Accelerate the work among child workers.

8. Struggles in Sung Hing Ho. & Cotton Mill:-
(1) Endeavour to start a strike of the whole body of

(2) Pick out energetic elements in the strike and

(3) Accelerate propaganda and educational work in

5. 恒丰棉纺厂工人反对“五天轮班制”和解雇的斗争。启动上述斗争的准备工作早已进行，但因以下原因尚未实施：-
(1) 同志们的动摇以及缺乏胜利的希望。
(2) 同志们缺乏精力。
(3) 未能抓住出现的机会。
(4) 活动局限于厂内的湖南帮。
(5) 忽视在女工中的活动。
(6) 忽视在青年工人中的活动。
(7) 附属组织不健全。

未来在恒丰厂发展活动的计划：-
(1) 开展教育工作，使同志们对阶级斗争有清晰的认识。
(2) 努力说服同志们保持活力。
(3) 组织“突击队”在上海工人和女工中开展活动，并扩展党的组织。
(4) 扩展工会和反帝同盟，建立互济会和共产主义青年团的分支。
(5) 加速在女工和青年工人中的工作。
(6) 加速反对黄色工会和同乡会的运动。

6. 三新棉纺厂的斗争：-
(1) 发起反对解雇的斗争；要求停工期间的工资；推翻工贼。
(2) 通过吸收积极分子来发展党的组织。
(3) 发展厂内的各种组织。

7. 伟通棉纺厂的斗争：-
(1) 在一周内建立党支部。
(2) 发展并巩固群众组织。
(3) 加速在童工中的工作。

8. 松兴和棉纺厂的斗争：-
(1) 利用一个部门工人的斗争，努力发动全体工人罢工。
(2) 挑选罢工中的积极分子，诱导他们入党。
(3) 加速宣传和教育工做，以使工人了解政治局势。

page_data.en:
Summarised description of contents of Communist Booklet
(Exhibit No.23, Changping Road Communist Case) entitled
"The Present Political Situation in China and the Principal
Duties of the Chinese Communist Party".
(Issued by the U.S.S.R. Foreign Labourers Publishing Co.)
~~1st March 1932.~~ Published in Moscow in June 1932.

Chapter I - The Two Opposing Governments in China.

This refers to the Kuomintang Government (Nanking) and
the Soviet Government (Kiangse) which was established on
the conclusion of the First Chinese Soviet Congress held at
Suikin on November 7,1931. This chapter mentions the
merits of the Soviet rule and quotes various articles from
the Soviet constitution concerning the imperialistic Powers,
labour, peasant and economic problems, etc. One of these
articles (No.8) states :
"The object of the Chinese Soviet Government is to free
"China from the imperialistic yoke and to restore to the
"Chinese people their independence and autonomy. The
"Soviet Government does not recognize the special political
"and economic rights enjoyed in China by Imperialistic
"Powers,and all unequal treaties concluded between these
"Powers and the reactionary Government are declared null
"and void. No foreign loans are recognized and no
"troops, warships and aeroplanes belonging to any
"Imperialistic country are ~~not~~ allowed to enter Soviet
"territory.................... etc."

Chapter II - The Partitioning of China and the People's
Revolutionary War.

This chapter refers to the Japanese policy towards
Manchuria and Soviet Russia. Japan's possession of Manchuria
is only part of a general scheme of the Imperialistic Powers
to partition China and to attack Soviet Russia. A revolution-
ary war participated by millions of the Chinese masses under
the leadership of the Communist Party only can save China
from being subjugated by Japan, Great Britain, U.S.A. and
France. The writer then enumerates the various reasons why
this war is absolutely necessary and how a successful
conclusion is possible. Lenin said that such a revolution
would be successful. This chapter also mentions the
Shanghai Sino-Japanese conflict, the activities of the 19th
Route Army and the attitude of Chiang Kai-shek and other
politicians during the fighting.

Chapter III - The Chinese Revolutionary Situation and
Communist Party's Principal Task.

This chapter discusses the revolutionary situation in
China at length, and states that the present reactionary rulers
will not be able to continue their rule successfully because
the people under their rule cannot endure their sufferings
any longer and are all on the point of rising to overthrow
the reactionary rulers. The principal task of the Communist
Party will be to combine the land revolution and anti-
imperialistic revolution into one big mass revolution in
order to attain the final object of securing the independence
and unification of China and emancipation of its people.
To carry out this task the Chinese Communist Party must
first consolidate the party on the lines laid down by Lenin.

共产党小册子内容摘要（昌平路共产党案件第23号证物），题为《中国目前的政治局势与中国共产党的主要任务》。
（由苏联外国工人出版社发行。）
~~1932年3月1日。~~ 1932年6月出版于莫斯科。

第一章 - 中国的两个对立政府。

此处指国民党政府（南京）和苏维埃政府（江西），后者是在1931年11月7日于瑞金举行的第一次中华苏维埃代表大会结束后建立的。本章提及苏维埃统治的优点，并引用苏维埃宪法中关于帝国主义列强、劳工、农民和经济问题等的各种条款。其中一条款（第8条）规定：
“中华苏维埃政府的目标是将中国从帝国主义的枷锁中解放出来，恢复中国人民的独立和自主。苏维埃政府不承认帝国主义列强在中国享有的特殊政治和经济权利，宣布这些列强与反动政府签订的所有不平等条约无效。不承认任何外债，不允许任何帝国主义国家的军队、战舰和飞机进入苏维埃领土.................... 等。”

第二章 - 瓜分中国与人民革命战争。

本章涉及日本对满洲和苏俄的政策。日本占据满洲只是帝国主义列强瓜分中国和进攻苏俄的总体计划的一部分。只有在共产党领导下，由数百万中国群众参与的革命战争，才能使中国免于被日本、英国、美国和法国征服。作者随后列举了这场战争绝对必要的原因以及如何可能取得成功结局。列宁曾说这样的革命会成功。本章还提及上海中日冲突、第十九路军的活动以及蒋介石和其他政客在战斗期间的态度。

第三章 - 中国革命形势与共产党的主要任务。

本章详细讨论中国的革命形势，指出目前的反动统治者将无法继续成功维持其统治，因为其统治下的人民再也无法忍受苦难，都正处于起来推翻反动统治者的边缘。共产党的主要任务是将土地革命和反帝革命结合成一场大规模群众革命，以实现确保中国独立统一和人民解放的最终目标。为了完成这一任务，中国共产党必须首先按照列宁制定的方针巩固党。

Date March 21, 1934.

Subject (in full) Letter from Mr. Van den Berg of the Consulate General for
the Netherlands dated March 10, 1934.

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by （签名）

With reference to the above letter, paragraph three.
The handwriting appearing on the envelope of the letter addressed
to Mr. W.v.d. Berg, No. 225 Seymour Road, Shanghai, from Louis
de Visser, Communist Member of the Netherlands Parliament (See
file No. D.4927 and Files Nos. D.4067 and D.4424 on the subject
of Tan Malakka) has a light resemblance to that appearing in
document No. 112 impounded as the result of the raid conducted
on No. 677 Changping Road on March 2, 1934, but under close
examination shows many points of difference. Document No.112
is undated, it is therefore difficult to say exactly when it was
written. The reference in Document No. 112 to the change in
Berlin obviously refers to the action of Herr Adolf Hitler who
is at present at the helm of German political affairs and who
refuses to countenance party politics and who has waged an
unrelenting war on Communism for the past ten months. Bearing
the foregoing facts in mind the letter (No. 112) would not be
more than six months old and is in all probability a draft of
a cablegram or code letter since it appears not to have left
Shanghai.

The copies and/or translations of documents called for
by Mr. Van den Berg are hereto attached for favour of forwarding.

（签名）
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Berg 先生、来自荷兰议会共产主义议员路易斯·德·维瑟（Louis de Visser）的信封上的笔迹（参见档案号 D.4927 以及关于丹·马拉卡（Tan Malakka，音译）主题的档案号 D.4067 和 D.4424），与1934年3月2日在昌平路677号突袭行动中查获的第112号文件上的笔迹略有相似，但经仔细检查，显示出许多不同之处。第112号文件未注明日期，因此很难确切说明其书写时间。第112号文件中提到的柏林的变化，显然指的是阿道夫·希特勒（Adolf Hitler）先生的行动，他目前掌管德国政治事务，拒绝容忍政党政治，并在过去十个月中对共产主义发动了无情的战争。鉴于上述事实，该信件（第112号）的时间不会超过六个月，而且很可能是一份电报或密码信的草稿，因为它似乎并未离开上海。

亲爱的吉文斯：

非常感谢你方1934年3月7日关于在昌平路677号查获文件的 D-5703 号来信。
如蒙惠赐第112号证物的另外两张照片，以及关于爪哇和荷属东印度共产主义活动的报告副本（即第一被告杨义玲散落的文件中的第6号），我将不胜感激。

一旦第101号证物的译文完成，我希望也能收到一份副本。

值得请专家将去年第3613号照片上的笔迹（据称是荷兰共产主义者、议会议员*路易斯·德·维瑟写给上海西摩路225号 W.v.d.Berg 关于丹·马拉卡的信）与第112号证物的笔迹进行比较。在我看来，两者有许多相似之处。

如果与此案有关的被捕人员就上述文件作出任何陈述，如蒙告知，我将非常感激。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5703
Date 2 / 3 / 34

March 2, 1934.

POLITICAL

Communist Propaganda - Arrests.

Acting on the Authority of a warrant issued at the
instance of the Shanghai Bureau of Public Safety, the
Municipal Police at 12.30 a.m. March 2, raided a communist
base at 677 Changping Road and effected the arrest of three
male Chinese named Yang Yih-ling (楊一林), Liu Kwei-ching
(劉貴卿) and Tsang Ts-Yuen (張子雲). a considerable
quantity of communist literature in the Chinese language
and also manuscripte in Russian and English were seized.

The five prisoners, four of whom are claimed by the
Chinese Authorities to be members of the Kiangsu Provincial
Committee of the Chinese Communist Party, will be taken
before Court on March 2 when a write of Detention will
be applied for to enable further investigation to be made.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室。
编号 D 5703
日期 1934 年 3 月 2 日

1934 年 3 月 2 日。

政治类

共产主义宣传 - 逮捕行动。

根据上海公安局申请签发的搜查令授权，市警察局于 3 月 2 日凌晨 12 时 30 分突袭了位于昌平路 677 号的共产主义据点，并逮捕了三名中国男子，分别是杨一林、刘贵卿和张子雲。查获了大量中文共产主义文献以及俄文和英文手稿。

五名囚犯中，有四名被中国当局声称是中国共产党江苏省委成员，他们将于 3 月 2 日被提堂，届时将申请拘留令以便进行进一步调查。

page_data.en:
Extract of Proceedings in S. S. D. Court for        19    F. I. R. No.        Stn. No.
Reg. No. 6/31954-6    Stn. Gordon Rd    Procurator        Judge

Sheet No.2.

1st accused :- I was waiting in the house for my friend to return.
I was told not to move by the Police, how could I throw anything
away. I opened the door as I thought my friend was returning.
I am not a Communist. I know the father of the 2nd accused. The
2nd accused owed me $95.00 in all.

2nd accused :- I rented the house at No.677 Changping
Road. I am not a Communist. The literature seized was not found
in my room. One named Liu lived in the room upstairs in the room
where the literature was found. Liu was seldom in his room. I do not
know why he did not return yesterday. I do not know the 3rd
accused. One of the keys to the house is mine. Liu was in possession
of a key which I gave him.

3rd accused :- I came to Shanghai yesterday from Honan.
After getting off the train I met a friend who took my luggage
and I lost him. I knocked on the door whilst trying to find
him. I was arrested by the detective. I ran away as I was
frightened. The key found by the Police is not mine. I came to
Shanghai to buy goods.

Wong Vang Chuen P.S.,Bureau :- The Public Safety
Bureau had received information that No.677 Changping Road was
being occupied by Communists. A warrant was applied for. The
1st accused is known to me as a Communist.

DECISION.

Remanded till the 6th of March 1934, 10.am. for
further investigation.

Enger

上海特区法院诉讼程序摘录    19    F. I. R. 编号        警局编号
登记编号 6/31954-6    戈登路警局    检察官        法官

第2页。

第一被告：- 我在屋内等待朋友回来。
警察叫我不要动，我怎么能扔掉任何东西呢。
我以为朋友回来了，就打开了门。
我不是共产党人。我认识第二被告的父亲。
第二被告总共欠我95.00美元。

第二被告：- 我租住了昌平路677号的房子。
我不是共产党人。被查获的宣传品并非在我的房间内发现。
一个姓刘的人住在楼上发现宣传品的房间里。
刘某很少在他的房间里。我不知道他昨天为什么没回来。
我不认识第三被告。这所房子的一把钥匙是我的。
刘某持有我给他的一把钥匙。

第三被告：- 我昨天从河南来到上海。
下火车后，我遇到一位朋友，他拿了我的行李，
但我跟丢了他。我在试图寻找他时敲了门。
我被侦探逮捕了。因为害怕，我逃跑了。
警察发现的钥匙不是我的。我来上海是为了进货。

黄万全（Wong Vang Chuen，音译），公共安全局警务处：-
公共安全局收到情报称，昌平路677号正被共产党人占用。
随即申请了搜查令。
据我所知，第一被告是共产党人。

裁决。

还押候审，直至1934年3月6日上午10时，
以便进一步调查。

恩格（Enger）

Hunan. Wife of the 2nd accused.
Both of the above arrived in Shanghai at the end of

On 1-3-34 when the premises were first

was found that would connect them with the communistic
activities being conducted on the premises. However,
they were kept under observation, and as stated above
were arrested by warrant at 5 p.m. 2-3-34.

The 4th, 5th, and 6th accused will appear
before the S.S.D. Court on 3-3-34 when a writ of Deten-

Each of the two females (5th & 6th accused)
has with her a small child. At present they are in
the custody of their mothers, no other person being
found to care for them.

The premises at 677 Changping Road are now
unoccupied. Uniformed police have been placed there
to protect the property, orders re its disposal
will be sought for from the S.S.D. Court later. An
inventory of the said property is being prepared.

Zau Ling(趙林), age 28,
Tientsin D.S.I. Prokofiev
Gordon Rd.Stn. 2.3.34. Clerk Zung Zoong Oen.
My name is Zau Ling. I am 28 years of age, native of
Tientsin, ex-shop assistant. When I was 6 or 7 years old,
I studied for about two years under a private tutor. I can
read and write a little. Since then I worked as a hawker
hawker at my native place until I was 25 years of age, after
which I went to Ho Chien Hsien, Hopeh province, where I was
employed for two years as an assistant in a secondhand
clothing shop. I then left the shop and returned to my native
place and I have since been unemployed.
On Feb. 28 I came to Shanghai by rail from my native place
for the purpose of visiting my friend named Tseu Yoh Vung
(周学文) residing at No. 35 Doong Zung Li (同仁里), Tiendong
Road. Tseu was formerly a shop assistant in Tientsin and I
do not know his present occupation. I stayed in Tseu's
house for one night on February 28. On March 1 Tseu and his
wife left Shanghai stating that they were going to their native
place in Hupeh to attend to family affairs. I spent the
night of March 1 with a prostitute in a house in the vicinity
of Nanking Road.
At about 10 a.m., March 2, I went to find one named Lee
Ts Ming(李志明), to whom I had been introduced by Tseu at
his house on the night of Feb. 28. Lee told me that he lived
in a house at the corner of Connaught and Ferry Rds., but I
forgot the number of the house upon arrival at the place.
When I was enquiring about him there, I went by mistake to
No. 677 Chong Ping Road. I knocked at the back door and was
immediately arrested by the Police. I desired to see Lee
simply for the purpose of saying goodbye to him, as I intended

天津人。特别巡捕房普罗科菲耶夫
戈登路警署 1934年2月3日。书记员 Zung Zoong Oen。
我叫赵林。我今年28岁，天津人，前店员。我六七岁时，曾跟随私塾老师学习了大约两年。我能识写少量文字。此后，我在家乡做小贩直到25岁，之后前往河北省河间县，在一家旧衣店当了两年助手。随后我离开店铺返回家乡，此后一直失业。
2月28日，我从家乡乘火车来到上海，目的是拜访居住在提篮桥同仁里35号的朋友周学文。周以前是天津的一名店员，我不知道他目前的职业。2月28日晚，我在周家留宿了一夜。3月1日，周及其妻子离开上海，称要回湖北老家处理家事。3月1日晚，我在南京路附近的一处妓院与一名妓女共度一夜。
3月2日上午10点左右，我去寻找一位名叫李志明的人，他是2月28日晚周在其家中向我介绍的。李告诉我他住在康纳特路与费利路拐角处的一所房子里，但我到达那里时忘记了门牌号。当我在那里打听他时，我误入了昌平路677号。我敲了后门，随即被警察逮捕。我想见李只是为了向他道别，因为我打算

page_data.en:
(2)

to leave for Tientsin on the night of March 2.

I do not know any of the persons arrested at No. 677
Chong Ping Road.

The money found in my possession ($171. in banknotes)
was given to me by my friend Tseu prior to his departure
for my maintenance, as I am unemployed. The fur-lined
long gown, which I am wearing, was left behind by Tseu, and
the two keys found in my possession also belonged to him.

I am not a communist and I know nothing about communism.

(Zau Ling.)
page_data.zh:
(2)

于3月2日晚离开前往天津。

我不认识在昌平路677号被捕的任何人员。

在我身上发现的现金（171美元纸币）是我的朋友周在离开前给我的生活费，因为我处于失业状态。我身穿的皮袍长衫是周留下的，在我身上发现的两把钥匙也属于他。

我不是共产党员，我对共产主义一无所知。

（赵林。）

page_data.en:
5
Liu Tsang Sz (劉張氏), 26.
Hunan. D.S.I. Prokofiev
Gordon Rd.Stn. 2.3.34 Clerk Zung Zoong Oe
My name is Liu Tsang Sz. I am 26 years of age, native of Hunan, married.
I have never attended any school, but I can read a few Chinese characters. At the age of twenty-two I was married at my native place to a man named Liu Lao Nyi (劉老二) who is a land owner. I lived with my husband at my native place until about two and half months ago when I came to Shanghai with my brother-in-law named Liu Kwei Ching (劉貴卿) and his family. My husband remained home.
Following our arrival here we stayed in a lodging house in the Settlement for about ten days, after which we went to live at No. 677 Chong Ping Road. This house was rented by my brother-in-law (Liu Kwei Ching). I do not know what business he did before, but I know that he is at present unemployed. I came to Shanghai just for sight-seeing and I have been staying with my brother-in-law as his guest, occupying the room over kitchen with my child.
About two weeks after we had moved in, the upstairs front room was rented by a married couple. The woman left Shanghai soon afterwards owing to sickness, while the man was living there all the time. He left the house at about 8 p.m. March 1 and failed to return. I do not know either his name or occupation, and I have no knowledge whatever about the books etc. seized by the police in his room.
The first accused, whose name I do not know, called on my brother-in-law on three occasions during the past month to collect some debt from him. I have never seen the 2nd and 4th accused. I am not a communist.
(Liu Tsang Sz)
page_data.zh:
5
刘张氏，26岁。
湖南人。特别巡捕房普罗科菲耶夫
戈登路警署 1934年2月3日 书记员 Zung Zoong Oe
我叫刘张氏。我今年26岁，湖南人，已婚。
我从未上过学，但能认几个汉字。二十二岁时，我在家乡嫁给了一位名叫刘老二的男子，他是一名地主。我与丈夫在家乡生活，直到约两个半月前，我随小叔子刘贵卿及其家人来到上海。我丈夫仍留在老家。
抵达此处后，我们在租界的一家客栈住了约十天，随后搬至昌平路677号居住。这所房子是我小叔子（刘贵卿）租下的。我不知道他以前做什么生意，但我知道他目前失业。我来上海只是为了观光，作为客人寄居在小叔子家，带着孩子住在厨房上面的房间里。
我们搬进去约两周后，楼上前间租给了一对夫妇。那女人不久后因生病离开了上海，而男人则一直住在那里。他于3月1日晚上8点左右离开住所，未再返回。我不知道他的姓名或职业，对警察在他房间里查获的书籍等物也一无所知。
第一被告，其姓名我不知道，在过去一个月里曾三次拜访我的小叔子，向他讨债。我从未见过第二和第四被告。我不是共产党员。
（刘张氏）

page_data.en:
6

Liu Loo Sz(刘吕氏), age 30,
Sinyang Foo, Hunan.           D.S.I. Prokofiev
Gordon Rd.Stn.      2.3.34            Clerk Zung Zoong Oen

My name is Liu Loo Sz. I am 30 years of age, native
of Sinyang Foo, Hunan, married.

I have never studied in any school, and I can neither
read nor write Chinese. At the age of 25, I was married
to a man named Liu Kwei Ching(刘贵卿) who was then a school
teacher at my native place. During the autumn of 1933 my
husband visited Shanghai in order to find work as my native
place is infested by bandits. He soon returned and about two
and half months ago we came to Shanghai together with Liu
Tsang Sz(刘张氏), my sister-in-law. Upon arrival, we lived
in a lodging house for several days, after which we went to
live at No. 677 Chong Ping Road, a house rented by my husband
Liu Kwei Ching. My husband has been out of employment for
the past two years and we are living on the money sent from
his home in Hunan.

We occupied the ground floor front room, while my sister-
in-law was living with her child in the room over kitchen.
About one month ago, the front upstairs room was rented by a
man who gave his name as "Liu" and his occupation as
assistant in a certain bookstore. A woman, who appeared to
be his sweetheart, occasionally stayed over-night with him.
She was last seen several days ago. All the suitcases seized
by the police in Liu's room were brought in by the latter
at the time he moved in. I have no knowledge of the contents
of the suitcases. About 5 p.m. or 6 p.m., March 1, Liu
left the house and failed to return.

The first accused, whose name I do not know, is my
husband's friend. I never saw him before. He called on
page_data.zh:
6

刘吕氏，30岁，
湖南信阳府人。           特别巡捕房普罗科菲耶夫
戈登路警署      1934年2月3日            书记员 Zung Zoong Oen

我叫刘吕氏。我今年30岁，湖南信阳府人，已婚。

我从未在任何学校读过书，既不会读也不会写中文。25岁时，我嫁给了当时在家乡当教员的刘贵卿。1933年秋，因家乡匪患严重，我丈夫来上海找工作。他很快返回，约两个半月前，我们与我嫂嫂刘张氏一同来到上海。抵达后，我们在一家客栈住了几天，随后搬至我丈夫刘贵卿租下的昌平路677号居住。我丈夫已失业两年，我们靠他从湖南老家寄来的钱生活。

我们住在一楼前间，而我嫂嫂带着孩子住在厨房上面的房间里。约一个月前，楼上前间租给了一个自称姓“刘”的男子，职业是某书店的助手。一名看似是他情妇的女子偶尔与他过夜。最后一次见到她是几天前。警察在刘某房间里查获的所有手提箱都是后者搬进来时带入的。我不知道箱子里装的是什么。3月1日下午5点或6点左右，刘离开住所，未再返回。

第一被告，其姓名我不知道，是我丈夫的朋友。我以前从未见过他。他来访

page_data.en:
Liu Loo Sz (Page 2)

my husband at about 6 p.m. on March 1 but the latter was out.
While he was waiting for my husband's return, the police
arrived. As far as I know he came to collect a debt from
my husband.
I have never seen the third and fourth accused.
I am not a communist and I know nothing about communism.

(Liu Loo Sz).
page_data.zh:
刘吕氏（第2页）

我丈夫是在3月1日下午6点左右，但当时我丈夫外出了。
当他等待我丈夫回来时，警察到了。据我所知，他是来向我丈夫讨债的。
我从未见过第三和第四被告。
我不是共产党员，我对共产主义一无所知。

（刘吕氏）。

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
Assistance to Chinese Authorities.

At 11.0 p.m. 1-3-34, D.S.I. Prokofiev attached to the Special Branch, accompanied by Det. Insp. Wong Yen Tsing (王文俊) of the Public Safety Bureau came to this Station for assistance to execute Search Warrant No.1530 issued by the S.S.D. Court to search a Chinese dwelling house situated at 677 Changping Road suspected of containing communistic literature.

The necessary assistance was rendered and in an upstairs room a large quantity of communistic literature was seized, specimens of which will be produced in Court and the bulk scrutinized by the Special Branch.

Yang Yih Ling (楊一林) aged 30 years, native of Chekiang, m/schoolteacher, who was on the premises at the arrival of the Police was taken into custody. He was observed by C.D.S.90 to drop six documents which proved to be of communistic nature.

During the time of searching one Liu Kwei Ching (刘貴卿) aged 27 years, native of Hunan, m/unemployed entered the premises and was placed under arrest.

At 1.30 a.m. 2-3-34 C.D.S.90 and C.D.C. 293 arrested one Tsang Ts Yung (張子雲) aged 29 years, native of Hunan, s/unemployed, who entered the premises with a private key. On seeing detectives he attempted to escape but was easily frustrated.

（批：Noted. D.R. of 2/3/34.
S2, Further reports in due course.

协助中国当局。

1934年3月1日晚上11点，附属于政治部的特别巡捕房督察普罗科菲耶夫，陪同公安局侦探督察王文俊来到本警署请求协助，执行特区法院签发的第1530号搜查令，搜查位于昌平路677号的一处疑似藏有共产主义文献的中国民居。

提供了必要的协助，在楼上一个房间内查获了大量共产主义文献，其中样本将在法庭出示，其余大部分由政治部审查。

杨一林，30岁，浙江人，男/教员，警察到达时正在该处所内，被拘留。刑事侦缉处90号警员观察到其掉落六份文件，经证实具有共产主义性质。

Liu Kwei Ching(    ), age 27,
Hunan                D...i. . rokfiev
Go ru n a..tn.       ..a..,.2.3.34        C.erk . .oung

My name is Liu Kwei Ching. I am 27 years of age,
a native of Hunan, unemployed. I am at present residing
at 677 Chong Ping Road.

I studied in a primary school at my native from the age
of 10 to 17 years. After leaving school, I was employed
as a teacher in various schools at my native place until
October, 1933. when I came to Shanghai together with my
wife and boy in order to find employment. Following
my arrival in Shanghai I lived in various lodging houses
in the settlement until January 1934 when I rented house
No. 677 Chong Ping Road. I have been unable to find a
job and have been living all this on the money (about $800)
which I brought with me. The upstairs front room was
rented about one month ago by one named Liu who told me
that he was employed at a bookstore, the address of which
I do not know. A few visitors used to come to see him but
I never paid much attention to them. I have no knowledge
whatever of the communist literature found in his room.
He was the sole occupant of this room. He left his room
about tiffin time yesterday and failed to return. This
man speaks northern dialect and also can speak Shanghai
dialect.

The woman living in the room over kitchen is my sister-
in-law. She has been living with me since I rented the
house. Her husband left for Hunan long ago and he has never
been to my house.

The first accused is my friend whom I have not seen for
page_data.zh:
刘贵清（Liu Kwei Ching），27岁，
湖南人                D...i. . rokfiev
Go ru n a..tn.       ..a..,.2.3.34        书记员 . .oung

我叫刘贵清。现年27岁，
湖南人，无业。目前居住在
崇平路677号。

我10岁至17岁时在家乡的一所小学读书。毕业后，我在家乡的各学校担任教师，直至1933年10月，我与妻子及儿子一同来到上海谋职。抵达上海后，我在租界内的各寄宿舍居住，直到1934年1月租下崇平路677号的房屋。我一直未能找到工作，这段时间全靠我带来的钱（约800元）生活。楼上前间大约于一个月前租给了一位姓刘的人，他告诉我他在一家书店工作，但我不知道那家书店的地址。偶尔有访客来看他，但我从未多加留意。我对在他房间里发现的共产主义文献一无所知。他是该房间的唯一居住者。昨天午饭时分他离开了房间，此后未归。此人讲北方方言，也会说上海话。

住在厨房楼上房间的是我的弟媳（或嫂/妹/姐之妻，原文sister-in-law）。自从我租下这所房子以来，她就一直与我同住。她的丈夫很久以前就去了湖南，他从未到过我家。

第一被告是我的朋友，我已多年未见，

page_data.en:
(2)
many years so that I could hardly recognize him when I saw
him. He came to Shanghai to see me about the money ($90)
which I owe him. I never saw the third accused.
I am not a member of the communist party.

(Liu Kwei Ching).
page_data.zh:
(2)
以至于见到他时几乎认不出来。他来上海是为了向我讨要我欠他的钱（90元）。我从未见过第三被告。
我不是共产党党员。

（刘贵清）。

page_data.en:
Ts ng Ts Yung(          ), age 29,
Hunan                          D.S.I. Prokufiev.
Gordon Rd.Stn.    2.30a.m. 2.3.34            Clerk Z.C.Zung.

    My name is Tsang Ts Yung(          ).  I am 29 years of
age, native of Nanyang, Hunan, unemployed.
    I studied for two years at my native place when I was
young, after which I was employed as a shop assistant until
my departure for Shanghai a few days ago.    The object of
my coming here was to find employment.  I arrived in
Shanghai by train at about 11 p.m. March 1, 1934.  At the
railway station I was met by a friend of mine named Wong
Sz Zung(          ), also a native of Hunan.  He told me
that he was living at No. 14 Ferry Road and asked me to call
on him.    He took away my luggage when he left me.  A
little while later I took a ricksha and instructed the coolie
to take me to that address.    I am a stranger in Shanghai
and it happened that the ricksha coolie, instead of taking
me to 14 Ferry Road, went to the address where I was
arrested immediately upon arrival.    I did not open the
door of House No. 677 Chong Ping Road and had not the key
which the detectives alleges was found in my possession.
I had only three keys on me which I brought from my home.
    I do not know any of the persons arrested at 677
Chong Ping Road.    I am not a communist.

                        (Tsang Ts Yung)
page_data.zh:
曾子庸（Ts ng Ts Yung），29岁，
湖南南阳人                          D.S.I. Prokufiev.
戈登路巡捕房    凌晨2:30 1934年3月2日            书记员 Z.C.Zung.

我叫曾子庸（Tsang Ts Yung）。现年29岁，
湖南南阳人，无业。
我年轻时在家乡读了两年书，之后受雇为店员，直到几天前动身前往上海。我来此的目的是寻找工作。我于1934年3月1日晚上11点左右乘火车抵达上海。在火车站，一位名叫黄思宗（Wong Sz Zung，音译）的朋友来接我，他也是湖南人。他告诉我他住在斐伦路14号，并让我去拜访他。他离开时拿走了我的行李。过了一会儿，我雇了一辆人力车，吩咐车夫送我去那个地址。我在上海人生地不熟，碰巧人力车夫没有送我去斐伦路14号，而是把我拉到了我被捕的那个地址，我一到那里就被捕了。我没有打开崇平路677号的房门，也没有探员声称在我身上搜出的那把钥匙。我身上只有从家里带来的三把钥匙。
我不认识在崇平路677号被捕的任何人员。我不是共产党。

                        （曾子庸）

page_data.en:
Yang Yih Ling(          ), age 30,
Nyien Chow, Chekiang.           D.S.S. Province
Garden Rd. Stn.      1... .2.3.34             Clerk Sung Soong
                                                  O. n.

My name is Yang Yih Ling. I am 30 years of age, native
of Nyien Chow, Chekiang. unemployed teacher. About 5 years
ago, I graduated in commercial course of a law college in
Hangchow, after which I worked as a teacher in various
schools at my native place for about two years. Since
that time I have been without a fixed employment.
The day before yesterday I left Shaoshing, where I am
living, and came to Shanghai via Hangchow by train which
arrived here at about 6 p.m., March 1. My purpose of
coming to Shanghai was to collect a debt from my friend
named Liu Kwei Ching(          ), who was a schoolmate of mine
and whom I have not seen for years. From the railway
station I went to No. 677 Chung King Road where Liu Kwei
Ching is living. He was absent and I waited for him for
a long time. Then the police arrived and I was arrested.
I had no papers in my possession and did not drop any
on the floor as the detective states. I do not know the
third accused.
I am not a member of the Communist Party and I have not
been connected with communist activities.

(Yang Yih Ling).
page_data.zh:
杨义灵（Yang Yih Ling），30岁，
浙江宁波人（Nyien Chow，音译）           D.S.S. Province
花园路巡捕房      1... .1934年3月2日             书记员 Sung Soong
                                                  O. n.

我叫杨义灵。现年30岁，浙江宁波人（Nyien Chow，音译），失业教师。大约5年前，我从杭州一所法政学院的商科毕业，之后在家乡的学校任教约两年。从那以后，我一直没有固定职业。
前天我离开居住地绍兴，经杭州乘火车来沪，于3月1日下午6点左右抵达。我来上海的目的是向我的朋友刘贵清（Liu Kwei Ching）讨债，他是我的同学，我已多年未见。从火车站出发后，我前往重庆路677号，刘贵清住在那里。他不在家，我等了很长时间。随后警察赶到，我便被捕了。我身上没有携带任何文件，也没有像探员所说的那样将文件掉在地上。我不认识第三被告。
我不是共产党党员，也未参与过共产主义活动。

（杨义灵）。

SECOND BRANCH KIANGSU HIGH COURT (A.H.)
Proceedings. Mr.Y.T.Chang appeared for the Shanghai Municipal Council.
Mr.Y.T.Van appeared for the 1st accused.
Mr. Tsang Ping Sing appeared for the 2nd accused.
Mr.Dau Tseng Hau appeared for the 3rd accused.
Mr.Chang:- Here is a list of literature and the list
of furniture seized in the IMX accused house.
2nd accused:- I rent the house, but the literature
seized by the Police does not belong to me.
3rd accused:-The key is not mine and it was found
by Police not on my person.
1st accused:- I went to see the 2nd accused who is
my schoolmate and besides his father owes me $96.00 and thus I came
to Shanghai to claim my money.
4th accused:- I arrived from Tientsin and lived for
a week in my friend's house. I went to 677 Changping Road to see
a man named Lee when I was arrested.
5th accused:- I came to Shanghai with the 6th accused
who is the wife of the 2nd accused. I am a wife of the 2nd accused
brother. I can not read or write Chinese characters and one of
the tenant asked me to keep the box with the pamphlets. I do not
know what are their contents .
6th accused:- I came to Shanghai with the 5th accused
I am not a communist.
2nd accused:- I am not a communist.
3rd accused:- I am not a member of communist party.
Wong Vung Chuen, repres. of P.S.Bureau:- Here is a
Dispatch and we applied to the Court that the accused to be handed over to S.P.S.Bureau for further investigation.
Summed up.
Mr.Tseng appeared for the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau
Mr.Chang:- (in summing up) The S.M.C. has no objection
for the accused, except women, to be handed over to the P.S.Bureau

家具清单。
第二被告：房子是我租的，但警察查获的文献不属于我。

Charge
Application for writ of detention in accordance with Art.
42 of C.C.P. & R.O.
Application is hereby made for the detention of the above
named persons who were arrested at various times on 2.3.34.
at 677 Changping Road on suspicion of having been concerned in
communistic activities.
Compt. S.M.P.
Proceedings.
HIGH COURT A. M.
Mr T.Y.Chang appeared for the Shanghai Municipal Council.
Mr Chang :- This case is in connection with a case
brought before the Court yesterday. Three accused were previously
arrested at No.677 Changping Road. Detectives were left to keep
watch for any other persons arriving at the house. This 4th
accused arrived at the house at 9.30.am. on the 2/3/34 and was arrested.
The 4th accused states that he came to visit a friend named Lee
and that he had come from Tientsin to Shanghai with a man named
Tseu Yung Tung on the 23/2/34. He stated that he been living at
No.25 Jichang Road. The Police visited that address, nothing
of a Communistic nature was found there. At 5.pm. yesterday the
representative of the P.S.Bureau came to the station with two
warrants, one Search Warrant No.1525 and a Warrant for the
arrest of the 5th and 6th accused. (Warrants handed to Court).
Then the Police accompanied the P.S.Bureau representative to
the House at No.677 Changping Road and arrested the 5th and 6th
accused. The 5th accused states that she is the sister in law
of the 2nd accused. The 6th accused states that she is the wife
of the 1st accused. When the 1st, 2nd and 3rd accused were
arrested in the house on the 2/3/34 the 5th and 6th accused were
present. The P.S.Bureau did not ask for their arrest at that
time and they apparently obtained the names of the 5th and 6th
accused whilst listening to the S.M.Police detectives question-
ing them. The 5th and 6th accused have one child each and they
were kept in the detention cell with the accused last night.

指控
根据《刑事诉讼法》及《法院规则》第 42 条申请拘留令。
现申请拘留上述人员，他们因涉嫌参与共产主义活动，于 1934年3月2日在不同时间于昌平路 677 号被捕。
上海公共租界工部局警务处处长
诉讼程序。
高等法院 上午庭
张 T.Y. 先生代表上海工部局出庭。
张先生：- 本案与昨天提交法庭的案件有关。三名被告此前在昌平路 677 号被捕。侦探被留下监视抵达该房屋的其他人员。这第四名被告于 1934年3月2日上午 9:30 到达该房屋并被捕。
第四名被告称，他是来拜访一位姓李的朋友，并于 1934年2月23日与一名叫 Tseu Yung Tung（音译）的人从天津来到上海。他称一直居住在机场路 25 号。警方走访了该地址，未发现任何具有共产主义性质的物品。昨天下午 5 点，公共安全局（P.S.Bureau）的代表带着两张令状来到捕房，一张是搜查令第 1525 号，另一张是逮捕第五和第六名被告的逮捕令。（令状已呈交法庭）。随后，警察陪同公共安全局代表前往昌平路 677 号的房屋，逮捕了第五和第六名被告。第五名被告称她是第二名被告的嫂子弟媳（sister in law）。第六名被告称她是第一名被告的妻子。当第一、第二和第三名被告于 1934年3月2日在屋内被捕时，第五和第六名被告在场。当时公共安全局并未要求逮捕她们，她们显然是在旁听上海公共租界工部局警务处侦探审问时获知了第五和第六名被告的姓名。第五和第六名被告各有一名子女，昨晚她们与被告一起被关押在拘留室。

Should the 5th and 6th accused be detained then the Police men will have to remain on duty there for some time. I ask that the P.S.Bureau produce a Prima Facie case against the 5th and 6th accused today, if they cannot then I ask that the 5th and 6th accused be released on security pending their trial. The accused have all made statements, in which they deny being concerned in Communistic Activities. ( Handed to Court ).

Wang Vung Choon P.S.Bureau :- The two females were living on the premises as a blind to prevent any persons suspecting that the male members of the household were working as Communists. I ask that they be handed over to the P.S.Bureau for trial. The information we received was that the premises were being used by Communists. It was not stated as to whether they were male or female.

4th accused :- I went to the house to see a friend named Lee Ts Ming. I knocked at several doors in the vicinity and when I knocked at No.677 I was asked to come in. I was then arrested. I am not acquainted with any of the other accused. I am not connected with the Communist Party, I came to Shanghai to look for work.

5th accused :- I have a Husband in Honan. I came to Shanghai with my sister in law, the 6th accused. My husband is named Lou Liu Er. I can only read a few characters. I am not a communist.

6th accused :- The 2nd accused is my husband. I came to Shanghai with the 5th accused last year. My husband intended to obtain employment in Shanghai. I do not know whether he works for the Communist party. I am not a communist.

王云春（Wang Vung Choon，音译） 公共安全局：- 这两名女性住在该处所是为了掩人耳目，防止任何人怀疑家中的男性成员从事共产主义工作。我要求将她们移交给公共安全局进行审判。我们收到的情报是该处所被共产主义者使用。并未说明是男性还是女性。

第五名被告：- 我在河南有丈夫。我和我的嫂子弟媳（即第六名被告）一起来到上海。我丈夫名叫 Lou Liu Er（音译）。我只认识几个字。我不是共产主义者。

第六名被告：- 第二名被告是我的丈夫。去年我和第五名被告一起来到上海。我丈夫打算在上海找工作。我不知道他是否为共产党工作。我不是共产主义者。

Charge Application for writ of detention in accordance with Art. 48 of
C. of the R.S.
Application is hereby made for the detention of the above
named persons who were arrested at various times on 1/3/34
and 2nd 3/34 at 677 Changping road on suspicion of having been
concerned in communistic activities.

HIGH COURT, A.M.

Proceedings. Mr T.Y.Chang appeared for the Shanghai Municipal Council.
Mr Chang :- These accused were arrested on the 1/3/34
at 11.p.m. at No.677a Changping Road, on the Authority of a Warrant,
and at the request of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau. ( Warrant
handed to Court). A quantity of communistic literature was seized
in the house, and specimens have been brought to Court. ( Handed to
Court). C.D.F. 90 saw the 1st accused throw away these six papers.
( Handed to Court). The 2nd and 3rd accused were found to be in
possession of keys fitting the front door of the house. The 1st
accused stated that he came to Shanghai yesterday from Hangchow.
The 2nd accused stated that he had resided in the house for only
one month. The 3rd accused was arrested by detectives who had
been left to watch the house. The 3rd accused stated that he
had just arrived from Honan. As he had a key to open the front
door of the house it is obvious that he had been living in the
house. All the accused have made statements but deny being
communists. ( Statements handed to Court ).

1st accused :- I am not a Communist. I came from Hangchow
to Shanghai yesterday. I went to the house to locate my friend
named Lieu Kwai Ching. I did not throw any papers away.

C.D.F. 90 :- at 10.50.p.m. we raided the house. The 1st
accused attempted to escape by the back door. I arrested him.
He attempted to throw the papers away as he was being taken upstairs
by the detectives. The 2nd accused was arrested as he opened the
door. The 3rd accused opened the door with his own key and then
when he saw me he ran away. I gave chase and he fell and I struggled
with him and arrested him.

3. Tsang TaYung（音译） " 29，同上。

指控 根据《中华民国刑法》第 48 条申请拘留令。
现申请拘留上述人员，他们因涉嫌参与共产主义活动，于 1934年3月1日和 1934年3月2日在不同时间于昌平路 677 号被捕。

高等法院，上午庭。

诉讼程序。张 T.Y. 先生代表上海工部局出庭。
张先生：- 这些被告于 1934年3月1日晚上 11 点在昌平路 677a 号，凭逮捕令并应上海公共安全局的要求被捕。（逮捕令已呈交法庭）。在该房屋内查获了大量共产主义文献，样本已带至法庭。（已呈交法庭）。刑事侦缉队警员 90 号看见第一名被告扔掉了这六张纸。（已呈交法庭）。发现第二和第三名被告持有能打开该房屋前门的钥匙。第一名被告称他昨天从杭州来到上海。第二名被告称他在该房屋仅居住了一个月。第三名被告是被留下来监视房屋的侦探逮捕的。第三名被告称他刚从河南来到。由于他有钥匙可以打开房屋的前门，显而易见他一直住在这所房子里。所有被告均已作出陈述，但否认是共产主义者。（陈述书已呈交法庭）。

第一名被告：- 我不是共产主义者。我昨天从杭州来到上海。我去那所房子是为了找我的朋友 Lieu Kwai Ching（音译）。我没有扔掉任何纸张。

刑事侦缉队警员 90 号：- 晚上 10:50 我们突袭了该房屋。第一名被告试图从后门逃跑。我逮捕了他。当侦探将他带上楼时，他试图扔掉那些纸张。第二名被告在开门时被捕。第三名被告用自己的钥匙打开门，然后看到我时就逃跑了。我追赶他，他摔倒了，我与她搏斗并逮捕了他。
